intro.en: Industrial equipment harnesses connect control cabinets, sensors, actuators, motors, I/O modules and field devices inside a machine or production line. The harness is defined by the equipment layout and electrical drawing rather than by a universal model.
intro.zh: 工业设备线束用于连接控制柜、传感器、执行器、电机、I/O模块和现场设备。它不是通用固定型号，而是依据设备布局、电气图和安装路径定义。

knowledge.en: Power, control and sensitive signal circuits may require different routing, conductor, shielding and identification strategies. Branch position, service loop, bend allowance and strain relief affect whether the harness can be installed and maintained correctly.
knowledge.zh: 动力、控制与敏感信号回路可能需要不同的布线、导体、屏蔽和标识方案。分支位置、检修余量、弯曲空间和应力消除会直接影响安装与维护。

notes.en: Confirm the equipment layout, connector or terminal-block models, pin or terminal numbers, voltage and current, cable path, ambient temperature, oil or abrasion exposure and maintenance method. Similar-looking interfaces cannot be matched by appearance alone.
notes.zh: 需要确认设备布局、连接器或端子排型号、针脚或端子编号、电压电流、布线路径、环境温度、油污与磨损情况以及维护方式。外形相似的接口不能只凭外观匹配。

delivery.en: Engineering first reviews the drawing, BOM and routing constraints, then confirms materials and builds a sample. Branch dimensions, labels, connector orientation and continuity are checked against the approved sample before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 先审核图纸、BOM和布线限制，再确认物料并制作样品；经确认的分支尺寸、标签、接口方向和导通关系将作为后续重复生产的依据。

subtitle.zh: 一个小类，覆盖多种设备架构

lead.en: Industrial equipment harness is not one fixed model. It covers the complete family of harnesses used between control cabinets, PLC and I/O modules, sensors, servo motors, actuators, safety devices and field equipment. We can develop anything from a short internal jumper to a complex multi-branch machine harness, based on your drawing, sample, pin table or equipment layout.
lead.zh: 工业设备线束不是一个固定型号，而是覆盖控制柜、PLC与I/O模块、传感器、伺服电机、执行器、安全装置和现场设备之间连接的一整类产品。从机柜内短跳线到复杂的多分支整机线束，都可以根据图纸、样品、针脚表或设备布局进行开发。

method.en: Industrial Equipment Wire Harness Making Method
method.zh: 工业设备线束制作方法

copy.en: Pre-routed links for PLC, HMI, relays, terminal blocks, switches and cabinet doors, with wire numbers and service loops defined for installation and maintenance.
copy.zh: 用于PLC、HMI、继电器、端子排、开关和柜门之间的预制连接，可按装配与维护需求确定线号、出线和检修余量。

copy.en: Power, encoder, brake and feedback circuits can be combined or separated according to the drive system, shielding strategy and installation path.
copy.zh: 依据驱动系统、屏蔽策略和安装路径，可将动力、编码器、制动和反馈回路合并或分开配置。

copy.en: Multi-drop branches connect proximity switches, encoders, valves and field I/O. Branch length, connector direction and signal separation are built around the equipment layout.
copy.zh: 通过多分支结构连接接近开关、编码器、阀组和现场I/O，分支长度、接口方向与信号隔离方式围绕实际布局设计。

copy.en: Sealed connectors, conduit, braid, grommets and branch protection can be combined for equipment exposed to dust, oil, vibration, splash or frequent service.
copy.zh: 针对粉尘、油污、振动、飞溅或频繁检修环境，可组合密封接头、波纹管、编织套、护线圈和分支防护。

copy.en: Compact jumpers and organized looms connect boards, displays, power modules and panel-mounted components where routing space and assembly order are limited.
copy.zh: 在布线空间和装配顺序受限的机箱内，使用紧凑跳线和成束布线连接电路板、显示器、电源模块及面板器件。

copy.en: For reciprocating motion, conductor construction, cable jacket, bend radius, travel, clamp points and connector strain relief are reviewed as one complete routing system.
copy.zh: 面向往复运动工况，将导体结构、护套、弯曲半径、行程、固定点和接口应力防护作为完整布线系统审核。

copy.en: Copper construction and wire size are selected from actual current, voltage drop, flexing, termination and temperature requirements, not from connector appearance.
copy.zh: 根据实际电流、压降、弯曲工况、端接方式和温度要求选择铜导体结构与线径，不以接头外观代替计算。

copy.en: PVC, XLPE, PUR, TPE or other specified materials are evaluated against temperature, oil, abrasion, movement, chemical exposure and the customer's applicable document.
copy.zh: PVC、XLPE、PUR、TPE或其他指定材料，需结合温度、油污、磨损、运动、化学环境及客户适用文件进行审核。

copy.en: Foil, drain wire, copper braid, textile braid, conduit and heat-shrink solve different electrical or mechanical problems; the termination method is defined with the system grounding plan.
copy.zh: 铝箔、排流线、铜编织、纺织编织、波纹管和热缩材料分别解决不同的电气或机械问题，屏蔽端接需与系统接地方案一起确认。

copy.en: Housing, terminal, seal and cable diameter must form a compatible system. Original references, mating-part data or physical samples help prevent a similar-looking but incorrect match.
copy.zh: 壳体、端子、密封件与线缆外径必须形成兼容系统；原始型号、对插件资料或实物样品有助于避免“外观相似但无法互配”。

title.en: Build from drawing or pin table

copy.en: We review circuit mapping, branch datum, connector direction, labels and installation constraints before a first article is released.
copy.zh: 在首件制作前审核回路对应、分支基准、接口方向、标识和安装限制。

copy.en: A reference harness can be measured and mapped, but electrical function, mating interfaces and any hidden components still require customer confirmation.
copy.zh: 可对参考线束进行尺寸与回路整理，但电气功能、对插接口及隐藏元件仍需客户确认。

copy.en: When the original part is difficult to source, alternatives are compared by fit, terminal system, electrical rating, sealing and documented approval, not by appearance alone.
copy.zh: 原物料供应困难时，从装配、端子系统、电气额定、密封和书面批准等方面比较替代方案，不只比外观。

title.zh: 从快速样品到重复生产

copy.en: Sample feedback is converted into a controlled drawing, BOM and inspection plan so later batches reproduce the approved configuration.
copy.zh: 将样品反馈转化为受控图纸、BOM和检验计划，使后续批次持续复现已确认配置。

copy.en: PLC cabinets, distributed I/O, conveyors, actuators, safety switches and assembly cells.
copy.zh: PLC控制柜、分布式I/O、输送线、执行器、安全开关与装配单元。

copy.en: Spindle auxiliaries, sensors, lubrication, cooling, doors and internal control connections.
copy.zh: 主轴附件、传感器、润滑、冷却、安全门和机内控制连接。

copy.en: Motors, photoelectric sensors, heaters, valves, weighing modules and replaceable machine sections.
copy.zh: 电机、光电传感器、加热元件、阀组、称重模块与可更换机组。

copy.en: Conveyors, sorters, lifts, mobile modules, proximity detection and field communication.
copy.zh: 输送机、分拣机、升降模组、移动单元、接近检测与现场通信。

copy.en: Low-voltage controls, pumps, fans, sensors and auxiliary systems in storage, treatment and monitoring equipment.
copy.zh: 储能、处理与监测设备中的低压控制、泵、风机、传感器和辅助系统。

copy.en: Instrument panels, acquisition modules, test fixtures, internal interconnects and replaceable interface leads.
copy.zh: 仪表面板、采集模块、测试工装、机内互连和可更换接口线。

copy.en: Drawing, sample, pin map, load, environment, quantities and installation limits.
copy.zh: 确认图纸、样品、针脚、负载、环境、数量和安装限制。

copy.en: Freeze routing, branch datum, connector orientation, protection and inspection points.
copy.zh: 定义回路、分支基准、接口方向、防护和检验点。

copy.en: Confirm wire, terminal, housing, seal, sleeve, label and any approved alternatives.
copy.zh: 确认线材、端子、壳体、密封、套管、标签与认可替代。

copy.en: Cut, strip, crimp, assemble, protect and form the harness to the reviewed data.
copy.zh: 依据审核资料完成下线、剥线、压接、组装、防护与成型。

copy.en: Check dimensions, connector direction, labels, continuity and other agreed project items.
copy.zh: 核对尺寸、接口方向、标签、导通及其他约定项目。

copy.en: Release the approved drawing, BOM, work instruction and inspection record for repeat orders.
copy.zh: 依据已批准图纸、BOM、作业文件和检验记录进行重复产出。

copy.en: Sealed connector systems, correct cable diameter, cavity plugs, conduit and branch protection are selected for the actual exposure and agreed test method.
copy.zh: 根据实际暴露环境和约定测试方法，选择密封接口系统、匹配线径、堵孔件、波纹管和分支防护。

copy.en: Clips, routing clearance, braid, conduit, grommets and strain relief reduce repeated rubbing and concentrated load at branches and connectors.
copy.zh: 通过卡扣、路径间隙、编织套、波纹管、护线圈和应力防护，降低重复摩擦及分支、接口的集中受力。

copy.en: Material temperature range, bend radius, travel and clamp spacing are reviewed against the machine's real duty cycle rather than a generic category claim.
copy.zh: 将材料温度范围、弯曲半径、行程和固定间距与设备真实工作周期对照审核，不作脱离项目的通用寿命承诺。

copy.en: Power and sensitive circuits are separated where needed; twisted pairs, shielding and grounding are defined from the controller and system architecture.
copy.zh: 按需要隔离动力与敏感回路，双绞、屏蔽和接地方式依据控制器与系统架构定义。

copy.en: Defined branches, labels and connector orientation reduce on-machine cutting, tracing and rework.
copy.zh: 明确的分支、标识和接口方向，减少现场裁线、查线和返工。

copy.en: Circuit identification, service loops and replaceable interfaces help technicians locate and replace a branch.
copy.zh: 回路识别、检修余量和可更换接口，帮助技术人员快速定位与更换分支。

copy.en: The approved sample is translated into controlled documents and inspection points for later production.
copy.zh: 把确认样品转化为受控文件与检验点，用于后续重复生产。

title.en: A design matched to your machine

copy.en: Electrical function, routing, service access and environment are handled as one project instead of forcing a stock harness into the machine.
copy.zh: 将电气功能、布线、维护空间与环境作为同一项目综合处理，不用现货线束生硬套入设备。

copy.en: Super Smile was founded in Shenzhen in 2023. Our 3,000 m² factory and team of more than 100 people support engineering review, harness processing, assembly and inspection. Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection before shipment; any additional electrical, mechanical or environmental test is defined according to the project.
copy.zh: 超斯迈尔于2023年成立于深圳，拥有3000㎡工厂和100余人团队，可完成工程审核、线束加工、组装和检验。成品出货前进行导通与外观检查，其他电气、机械或环境项目则按具体订单约定。

q.en: Does industrial equipment harness mean one standard product?
q.zh: 工业设备线束是一个固定产品吗？

a.en: No. It is a family covering cabinet, motor, sensor, I/O, sealed, internal and moving harnesses. The actual assembly is defined by your electrical and mechanical data.
a.zh: 不是。它覆盖控制柜、电机、传感器、I/O、密封、机内及运动线束等多种结构，最终产品依据项目的电气与机械资料定义。

q.en: What can I send if I do not have a complete drawing?
q.zh: 没有完整图纸时可以提供什么？

a.en: A sample, connector photos, mating-part references, pin table, equipment layout and required lengths can start the review. Unknown electrical functions must still be confirmed before production.
a.zh: 可先提供样品、接口照片、对插型号、针脚表、设备布局和长度要求；不确定的电气功能仍需在生产前确认。

q.en: Can you make prototypes and small batches?
q.zh: 可以做样品和小批量吗？

a.en: Yes. Prototype and small-batch builds can be used to check fit, routing and electrical mapping before a controlled repeat order.
a.zh: 可以。可先通过样品或小批量确认装配、布线和电气对应，再转入受控的重复生产。

q.en: Can you match an existing connector?
q.zh: 可以匹配已有连接器吗？

a.en: We can review it from the original reference, mating connector data or a physical sample. A visual match alone is not enough to confirm the terminal, keying and seal system.
a.zh: 可通过原始型号、对插资料或实物样品进行审核；仅凭外观无法确认端子、防错和密封系统。

q.en: What is inspected before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前检查哪些项目？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection. Dimensions, polarity, insulation, pull force or other items are included when they are specified in the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通和外观检查；尺寸、极性、绝缘、拉力或其他项目，按已批准项目计划执行。

q.en: How do you keep repeat orders consistent?
q.zh: 重复订单如何保持一致？

a.en: The approved sample, drawing revision, BOM, work instruction, label rule and inspection points are kept as the controlled production reference.
a.zh: 以已批准样品、图纸版本、BOM、作业文件、标签规则和检验点作为受控生产依据。

intro.en: Control panel harnesses organize the connections between switches, indicator lamps, relays, PLC or HMI modules, terminal blocks and external equipment. They are designed around the panel layout and service method.
intro.zh: 控制面板线束用于组织开关、指示灯、继电器、PLC或HMI模块、端子排与外部设备之间的连接，结构围绕面板布局和检修方式设计。

knowledge.en: Panel depth, component spacing, door movement and terminal access determine branch length and exit direction. Clear wire numbers, terminal labels and defined connector keying reduce assembly and maintenance errors.
knowledge.zh: 面板深度、器件间距、柜门运动和端子操作空间决定分支长度与出线方向。清晰的线号、端子标识和防错接口有助于减少装配与检修错误。

notes.en: Provide the panel drawing, component model list, terminal schedule, door or hinge movement, wire-number rules and connection table. Confirm whether the harness is supplied loose, mounted to the panel or delivered with specified accessories.
notes.zh: 建议提供面板图、器件型号清单、端子表、柜门或铰链运动范围、线号规则和接线表，并确认线束是散装交付、面板预装还是连同指定附件交付。

delivery.en: After a layout and terminal review, a first assembly is checked on the actual panel or an agreed fixture. Terminal positions, labels, branch lengths and continuity are recorded before batch assembly.
delivery.zh: 完成布局与端子审核后，首件可在实际面板或约定工装上核对；端子位置、标签、分支长度和导通结果确认后再进行批量装配。

subtitle.en: One category, many panel layouts and service methods
subtitle.zh: 一个小类，覆盖多种面板布局与检修方式

lead.en: A control panel harness is not a single fixed loom. It includes pre-routed connections for cabinet doors, operator panels, PLC and HMI modules, relays, terminal blocks, power supplies, field interfaces and replaceable control assemblies. We define every branch around the actual panel drawing, component spacing, hinge movement, wire-number rule and installation sequence.
lead.zh: 控制面板线束不是单一固定线型，而是覆盖柜门、操作面板、PLC与HMI模块、继电器、端子排、电源、现场接口及可更换控制组件之间预制连接的一整类产品。每条分支都围绕实际面板图、器件间距、铰链运动、线号规则和安装顺序定义。

method.zh: 控制面板线束制作方法

copy.en: Pre-routed branches connect pushbuttons, selector switches, indicator lamps, emergency stops and door-mounted devices while allowing the required hinge movement and service loop.
copy.zh: 通过预制分支连接按钮、选择开关、指示灯、急停及柜门器件，同时预留所需的铰链运动范围和检修余量。

copy.en: Organized interconnects link controllers, I/O modules, displays, communication modules and power supplies with defined pin routes and connector orientation.
copy.zh: 以明确的针脚路径和接口方向，组织控制器、I/O模块、显示器、通信模块与电源之间的连接。

copy.en: Cut-to-length wires, jumpers, ferrules, terminals and labels can be prepared for relay banks, terminal strips, breakers and contactors according to the approved connection table.
copy.zh: 可依据确认的接线表，为继电器组、端子排、断路器和接触器准备定长导线、跳线、管形端头、端子与标识。

copy.en: Pluggable branches provide a repeatable boundary between the cabinet and sensors, motors, valves, actuators or replaceable machine modules.
copy.zh: 通过可插拔分支，在控制柜与传感器、电机、阀组、执行器或可更换设备模组之间建立可重复装配的接口边界。

copy.en: Harnesses can be supplied loose, formed for a specific panel or installed with agreed accessories so the customer's assembly team receives a controlled wiring set.
copy.zh: 线束可以散装交付、按指定面板预成型，也可连同约定附件预装，使客户装配团队获得受控的布线套件。

copy.en: Short pigtails and detachable branches make frequently serviced switches, displays, fans or field interfaces easier to remove without disturbing the complete cabinet loom.
copy.zh: 短尾线与可拆分支便于更换经常检修的开关、显示器、风扇或现场接口，不必扰动整套柜内线束。

copy.en: Wire size, strand construction and temperature class are selected from actual current, voltage drop, termination method, cabinet temperature and applicable project documents.
copy.zh: 根据实际电流、压降、端接方式、柜内温度和项目适用文件选择线径、绞合结构与温度等级。

copy.en: PVC, XLPE, PTFE, TPE or specified wire families are reviewed together with ducting, sleeving, grommets and clearance from heat or sharp metal edges.
copy.zh: PVC、XLPE、PTFE、TPE或指定线材体系，需要与线槽、套管、护线圈以及热源和金属锐边间距一起审核。

copy.en: Heat-shrink markers, sleeves, printed labels, color rules and terminal references are arranged around the customer's drawing and maintenance practice.
copy.zh: 热缩标识、号码管、打印标签、颜色规则和端子编号，围绕客户图纸及维护习惯统一定义。

copy.en: Power, switching and sensitive signal circuits are separated where required. Twisted pairs, shields and grounding methods follow the controller and cabinet architecture.
copy.zh: 按需要隔离动力、开关量与敏感信号回路，双绞、屏蔽和接地方式依据控制器与柜体架构确定。

title.en: Build from panel drawing and connection table
title.zh: 依据面板图与接线表制作

copy.en: We review component positions, terminal references, branch datum, door movement, wire numbering and connector orientation before releasing the first assembly.
copy.zh: 首件制作前审核器件位置、端子编号、分支基准、柜门运动、线号规则和接口方向。

title.en: Develop from an existing panel or sample
title.zh: 依据现有面板或样品开发

copy.en: An existing harness or cabinet can provide routing and interface references, while electrical function and any hidden jumpers still require confirmation.
copy.zh: 现有线束或控制柜可用于整理布线路径与接口资料，但电气功能及隐藏跳接仍需确认。

copy.en: Defined labels, color coding, keyed connectors and branch grouping reduce terminal mistakes during panel assembly and later service work.
copy.zh: 通过明确标签、颜色规则、防错接口和分支归组，减少面板装配及后续检修中的接线错误。

copy.en: The project can cover loose harnesses, pre-formed routing sets, specified accessories or agreed panel-side installation, depending on the customer's assembly boundary.
copy.zh: 可按客户装配边界提供散装线束、预成型布线套件、指定附件或约定的面板侧预装。

copy.en: PLC cabinets, assembly cells, conveyors, robot peripherals, safety circuits and distributed I/O panels.
copy.zh: PLC控制柜、装配单元、输送线、机器人外围、安全回路与分布式I/O面板。

copy.en: Operator stations, heater controls, drives, sensors, valves and replaceable process modules.
copy.zh: 操作站、加热控制、驱动器、传感器、阀组和可更换工艺模组。

copy.en: Control panels for fans, pumps, dampers, thermostats, sensors and building automation interfaces.
copy.zh: 用于风机、泵、风阀、温控器、传感器和楼宇自动化接口的控制面板。

copy.en: Fixture panels, production cells, inspection stations, material handling and line-side service interfaces.
copy.zh: 工装面板、生产单元、检测工位、物料搬运及线边检修接口。

copy.en: Low-voltage monitoring, auxiliary power, pump control, distribution and equipment-room panels.
copy.zh: 低压监测、辅助供电、泵控制、配电和设备间控制面板。

copy.en: Instrument racks, acquisition panels, test fixtures, safety interlocks and replaceable test interfaces.
copy.zh: 仪器机架、采集面板、测试工装、安全联锁和可更换测试接口。

copy.en: Confirm layout, component models, terminal schedule, circuit function, labels, quantities and installation boundary.
copy.zh: 确认布局、器件型号、端子表、回路功能、标识、数量和安装边界。

copy.en: Define branch datum, service loops, hinge movement, duct entry, connector orientation and protection points.
copy.zh: 定义分支基准、检修余量、铰链运动、线槽入口、接口方向与防护位置。

copy.en: Confirm wire, ferrule, terminal, connector, marker, sleeve and any approved alternatives.
copy.zh: 确认线材、管形端头、端子、连接器、标识、套管及认可替代物料。

copy.en: Cut and strip to the reviewed data, then crimp, terminate, mark and protect every circuit.
copy.zh: 依据审核资料完成下线与剥线，并对每个回路进行压接、端接、标识与防护。

copy.en: Check branch reach, terminal access, door movement, duct entry and the agreed panel-side assembly method.
copy.zh: 核对分支到达、端子操作空间、柜门运动、线槽入口及约定的面板侧装配方式。

copy.en: Verify continuity, circuit mapping, polarity where applicable, labels, dimensions and agreed workmanship points.
copy.zh: 核对导通、回路对应、适用时的极性、标签、尺寸和约定工艺项目。

copy.en: Conductor size, insulation, terminals and protective components are reviewed from the real circuit load and project requirements, not from a generic panel category.
copy.zh: 导体、绝缘、端子及保护元件依据真实回路负载与项目要求审核，不以通用面板类别代替计算。

copy.en: Wire numbers, terminal references and service loops are arranged so technicians can trace and replace a branch without obscuring adjacent devices.
copy.zh: 通过线号、端子编号和检修余量，让技术人员能够追踪并更换分支，同时不遮挡相邻器件。

copy.en: Power and sensitive circuits, shield termination and protective grounding are defined from the complete panel and equipment architecture.
copy.zh: 动力与敏感回路隔离、屏蔽端接及保护接地方式，依据完整面板与设备架构确定。

copy.en: The customer identifies the applicable machine, panel or market requirements. Materials, inspection items and documents are then confirmed for that project; the category page does not claim universal certification.
copy.zh: 由客户明确适用的设备、面板或市场要求，再针对项目确认材料、检验项目和文件；本类别页面不作通用认证声明。

copy.en: Pre-cut lengths, defined labels and prepared terminals reduce on-panel measuring, stripping and tracing work.
copy.zh: 预定长度、明确标识和已完成的端接，减少面板现场量线、剥线和查线工作。

copy.en: Organized branches and documented terminal references help maintenance teams locate a circuit and replace a service branch.
copy.zh: 有组织的分支与记录明确的端子编号，帮助维护人员定位回路并更换检修分支。

copy.en: The approved panel harness is converted into controlled drawings, material data, label rules and inspection points.
copy.zh: 把确认的面板线束转化为受控图纸、物料资料、标签规则和检验点。

title.en: A harness matched to the panel

copy.en: Branch lengths, service access, door movement and connection order are developed as one assembly instead of adapting a generic loose-wire set.
copy.zh: 把分支长度、维护空间、柜门运动和接线顺序作为同一装配系统开发，不用通用散线套件勉强适配。

q.en: Is a control panel harness one standard product?
q.zh: 控制面板线束是固定标准产品吗？

a.en: No. It is a category covering door looms, controller interconnects, terminal wiring, panel-to-machine interfaces, pre-installed sets and service branches. The finished assembly follows the actual panel data.
a.zh: 不是。它覆盖柜门线束、控制器互连、端子布线、面板至设备接口、预装套件和检修分支等结构，最终成品依据实际面板资料定义。

q.en: What information should be provided first?
q.zh: 首先需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: A panel layout, circuit or connection table, component models, terminal schedule, wire-number rule, hinge movement and delivery boundary are the most useful starting materials.
a.zh: 面板布局、回路或接线表、器件型号、端子表、线号规则、铰链运动范围和交付边界，是最有帮助的起始资料。

q.en: Can you match an existing panel harness?
q.zh: 可以匹配现有面板线束吗？

a.en: Yes. A sample or existing panel can be measured and mapped, but hidden jumpers, electrical function and mating references still require confirmation before production.
a.zh: 可以。可对样品或现有面板进行测量和回路整理，但隐藏跳接、电气功能及对插资料仍需在生产前确认。

q.en: Can labels and wire numbers follow our rules?
q.zh: 标签和线号可以按我们的规则制作吗？

a.en: Yes. The project can use the customer's numbering, color, sleeve, printed-label or barcode rules after the content and placement are approved.
a.zh: 可以。确认内容与位置后，可按客户的编号、颜色、号码管、打印标签或条码规则执行。

q.en: Can the harness be installed in the panel before delivery?
q.zh: 线束可以在交付前预装到面板吗？

a.en: The delivery boundary can include loose harnesses, pre-formed sets, specified accessories or agreed panel-side installation. The exact scope is confirmed during quotation and engineering review.
a.zh: 交付范围可以包括散装线束、预成型套件、指定附件或约定的面板侧预装，具体边界在报价与工程审核阶段确认。

q.en: Which tests are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些测试？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection. Circuit mapping, polarity, dimensions, pull force, insulation or other items are included when specified in the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查；回路对应、极性、尺寸、拉力、绝缘或其他项目，按已批准项目计划执行。

intro.en: Robotic harnesses carry power, control or sensor signals through moving axes, robot arms or end-of-arm tooling. Static cable construction is not automatically suitable for repeated bending or torsion.
intro.zh: 机器人线束用于在运动轴、机械臂或末端工具之间传输电源、控制或传感信号。适用于固定安装的线材，不一定适合持续弯折或扭转。

knowledge.en: Repeated bending, torsion and drag-chain travel create different mechanical loads. Bend radius, torsion angle, travel length, acceleration, clamping position and connector strain relief must be considered as one routing system.
knowledge.zh: 往复弯折、扭转和拖链运动产生的机械载荷不同。弯曲半径、扭转角度、行程、加速度、固定位置和接口应力消除需要作为一套运动系统共同评估。

notes.en: Do not select only by conductor count. Provide the robot or axis layout, motion video or path, expected cycle range, available bend radius, torsion angle, cable carrier information and electrical function. Actual life must be validated under the project motion profile.
notes.zh: 不能只按芯数选型。应提供机器人或运动轴布局、运动视频或路径、预期循环次数范围、可用弯曲半径、扭转角度、拖链信息和电气功能；实际寿命需按项目运动工况验证。

delivery.en: The sample stage confirms routing length, clamp points and connector orientation before motion testing by the customer or an agreed method. Production specifications are frozen only after the sample and motion conditions are accepted.
delivery.zh: 样品阶段先确认布线长度、固定点和接口方向，再由客户或按约定方法进行运动验证；样品与运动条件确认后，才冻结量产规格。

subtitle.en: Motion begins with the routing system
subtitle.zh: 运动可靠性从布线路径开始

lead.en: A robotic harness is a family of power, servo, brake, encoder, sensor, communication and tool-side assemblies developed around the real axis motion. Cable construction, bend radius, torsion, clamp position and connector support must work as one system.
lead.zh: 机器人线束是一类围绕真实轴运动开发的动力、伺服、制动、编码器、传感、通信及工具端组件。线材结构、弯曲半径、扭转、固定点和接口支撑必须作为同一系统协同设计。

copy.en: Power, brake, feedback and signal branches follow several rotating joints while maintaining defined service loops and supported transitions.
copy.zh: 动力、制动、反馈和信号分支随多个旋转关节运动，同时保持明确的检修余量与受控过渡。

copy.en: Compact moving assemblies require low-mass routing, stable branch geometry and clamp positions matched to acceleration and stroke.
copy.zh: 紧凑型高速机构需要低负载布线、稳定分支几何，并使固定位置与加速度和行程相匹配。

copy.en: Welding cells may combine power, control, cooling, sensing and tool circuits with protection selected for heat, sparks and mechanical contact.
copy.zh: 焊接单元可能同时包含动力、控制、冷却、传感与工具回路，并按热量、飞溅和机械接触选择防护。

copy.en: Replaceable grippers, vision units, valves and sensors can use a defined tool-side interface for quicker service and changeover.
copy.zh: 可更换夹具、视觉单元、阀组和传感器可采用明确的工具端接口，便于检修和换型。

copy.en: Linear travel assemblies are developed around carrier size, neutral-axis placement, cable fill, stroke and supported entry and exit points.
copy.zh: 直线往复组件围绕拖链尺寸、中性轴位置、填充率、行程及受支撑的进出口位置开发。

copy.en: Compact joint routing can combine low-voltage power, sensing and communication while preserving assembly access and controlled movement.
copy.zh: 紧凑关节布线可组合低压电源、传感和通信回路，同时保留装配空间并控制运动路径。

copy.en: Strand design and conductor size are selected from circuit load, voltage drop, bending duty, termination and project temperature requirements.
copy.zh: 依据回路负载、压降、弯折工况、端接方式及项目温度要求选择绞合结构与导体规格。

copy.en: PUR, TPE, PVC or specified cable families are reviewed against oil, abrasion, temperature, drag-chain travel, torsion and cleaning conditions.
copy.zh: PUR、TPE、PVC或指定线材体系，需要结合油污、磨损、温度、拖链运动、扭转与清洁条件审核。

copy.en: Encoder, resolver, vision and communication circuits may require paired conductors, shielding and grounding defined with the controller interface.
copy.zh: 编码器、旋变、视觉与通信回路可能需要双绞、屏蔽和接地，并与控制器接口共同定义。

copy.en: Connector backshells, boots, clamps, sleeves and transition points must prevent motion load from concentrating at terminals or cable exits.
copy.zh: 连接器尾附件、护套、夹具、套管与过渡位置，需要避免运动载荷集中在端子或出线口。

title.en: Develop from drawings and motion data
title.zh: 依据图纸与运动资料开发

copy.en: Review pin definitions, axis layout, motion path, stroke, torsion, bend radius, clamp locations, electrical load and installation sequence before sampling.
copy.zh: 打样前审核针脚定义、轴布局、运动路径、行程、扭转、弯曲半径、固定位置、电气负载与安装顺序。

title.en: Match an existing robot or sample
title.zh: 匹配现有机器人或样品

copy.en: A reference assembly can establish interfaces and routing, but hidden electrical functions and the real motion profile still require customer confirmation.
copy.zh: 参考组件可用于确认接口与路径，但隐藏的电气功能和真实运动曲线仍需客户确认。

copy.en: Tool-side, arm-side and cabinet-side segments can use agreed interface boundaries so one serviced branch does not require replacing the full dress pack.
copy.zh: 工具端、臂端与柜端可设置约定接口边界，使单个检修分支无需更换整套随动线束。

title.zh: 冻结已验证的运动样品

copy.en: After fit and motion verification, branch datums, clamp points, materials, labels and inspection items are recorded for repeat production.
copy.zh: 完成装配与运动验证后，记录分支基准、固定点、材料、标识和检验项目，用于后续重复生产。

copy.en: Axis power, encoders, sensors, grippers, valves and safety interfaces on automated lines.
copy.zh: 自动化产线中的轴动力、编码器、传感器、夹具、阀组和安全接口。

copy.en: Dress packs and tool circuits exposed to repeated motion, heat, sparks and shop-floor contact.
copy.zh: 承受重复运动、热量、飞溅和车间接触的随动线束与工具回路。

copy.en: Compact lightweight routing for fast axes, end effectors, sensors and machine interfaces.
copy.zh: 面向高速运动轴、末端执行器、传感器和设备接口的紧凑轻量化布线。

copy.en: Low-voltage power, control, sensing and communication inside compact articulated systems.
copy.zh: 紧凑多关节系统内部的低压电源、控制、传感与通信连接。

copy.en: Carrier-guided power, signal and feedback assemblies for long repetitive travel.
copy.zh: 用于长距离往复行程的拖链动力、信号与反馈组件。

copy.en: Robot-to-machine interfaces for doors, grippers, presence sensing and production control.
copy.zh: 用于柜门、夹具、到位检测和生产控制的机器人至机床接口。

copy.en: Confirm interfaces, loads, axis path, bending, torsion, stroke, environment, quantities and installation constraints.
copy.zh: 确认接口、负载、轴路径、弯折、扭转、行程、环境、数量和安装限制。

copy.en: Define branch datums, neutral-axis placement, clamp positions, connector orientation and service loops.
copy.zh: 定义分支基准、中性轴位置、固定点、接口方向和检修余量。

copy.en: Confirm cable families, connectors, terminals, shielding, sleeves, clamps, labels and approved alternatives.
copy.zh: 确认线材体系、连接器、端子、屏蔽、套管、夹具、标识及批准替代料。

copy.en: Cut, strip, crimp, assemble, form and protect the harness to the reviewed engineering data.
copy.zh: 依据审核后的工程资料完成下线、剥线、压接、组装、成型与防护。

copy.en: Check continuity, circuit mapping, polarity where applicable, labels, dimensions and agreed mechanical items.
copy.zh: 检查导通、回路对应、适用时的极性、标识、尺寸及约定机械项目。

copy.en: Verify the sample on the actual machine or an agreed motion setup before the production configuration is released.
copy.zh: 在实际设备或约定运动装置上验证样品，再放行量产配置。

copy.en: Cable construction and routing are reviewed for the real movement type; a cable suitable for a carrier is not automatically suitable for robot-joint torsion.
copy.zh: 线材结构和路径必须对应真实运动类型；适合拖链的线材并不自动适合机器人关节扭转。

copy.en: Available radius, cable separation, carrier space and entry support are confirmed together rather than treating the cable alone.
copy.zh: 可用半径、线缆隔离、拖链空间和入口支撑需要整体确认，不能只看线材本身。

copy.en: Backshell support, clamp distance and service loops reduce repeated load at crimps, solder joints and connector exits.
copy.zh: 尾附件支撑、固定距离和检修余量可减少压接点、焊点和接口出线处的重复载荷。

copy.en: Cycle life depends on the complete motion profile, materials and routing. Any target must be defined and validated for the customer's actual project.
copy.zh: 循环寿命取决于完整运动曲线、材料与路径；任何目标都必须针对客户实际项目定义并验证。

title.zh: 让运动与设备真正匹配

copy.en: The harness is developed around real axes, routes and interfaces instead of forcing a static cable set into a moving system.
copy.zh: 线束围绕真实轴、路径和接口开发，不把固定布线组件强行用于运动系统。

copy.en: Defined modules and labels help technicians isolate a serviced tool, branch or axis without disturbing unrelated wiring.
copy.zh: 明确的模块和标识便于技术人员隔离检修工具、分支或运动轴，不扰动无关布线。

title.zh: 形成可重复的制造资料

copy.en: Approved datums, materials, forming references and inspection points turn a successful sample into a controlled repeat build.
copy.zh: 把已批准基准、材料、成型参考和检验点记录下来，使成功样品转化为受控制的重复生产。

title.en: A system view of cable reliability
title.zh: 从系统角度看线缆可靠性

copy.en: Electrical function, mechanical motion, installation and maintenance are reviewed together instead of optimizing only one cable attribute.
copy.zh: 把电气功能、机械运动、安装和维护共同审核，而不是只优化线材某一个属性。

q.en: Is a drag-chain cable automatically suitable for a robot arm?
q.zh: 拖链电缆可以直接用于机器人手臂吗？

a.en: Not necessarily. Linear bending and multi-axis torsion impose different loads. The actual path, bend radius, torsion and clamp layout must be reviewed.
a.zh: 不一定。直线弯折与多轴扭转产生的载荷不同，必须审核真实路径、弯曲半径、扭转和固定布局。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide drawings or samples, pin definitions, circuit functions, robot or axis layout, motion path or video, stroke, bend radius, torsion, environment, quantity and testing needs.
a.zh: 建议提供图纸或样品、针脚定义、回路功能、机器人或运动轴布局、运动路径或视频、行程、弯曲半径、扭转、环境、数量和测试需求。

q.en: Can you match an existing robotic harness?
q.zh: 可以匹配现有机器人线束吗？

a.en: A sample can establish dimensions, interfaces and visible construction. Electrical function, hidden components and the real motion profile still require customer confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可用于确认尺寸、接口和可见结构，但电气功能、隐藏元件与真实运动曲线仍需客户确认。

q.en: Can power, feedback and communication be combined?
q.zh: 动力、反馈和通信可以组合吗？

a.en: They may share an assembly when separation, shielding, grounding, connector capability and mechanical routing are suitable for the project.
a.zh: 当隔离、屏蔽、接地、接口能力和机械路径适合项目时，可以在同一组件内组织这些回路。

q.en: How is motion life confirmed?
q.zh: 运动寿命如何确认？

a.en: A target motion profile and acceptance method must be agreed. Fit and motion validation may be performed on the customer's equipment or another approved setup before production release.
a.zh: 需要约定目标运动曲线与验收方法，可在客户设备或其他已批准装置上完成装配和运动验证，再放行量产。

q.en: Which inspections are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection. Circuit mapping, polarity, dimensions, pull force or motion-related items are included when specified in the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查；回路对应、极性、尺寸、拉力或运动相关项目，按已批准项目计划执行。

intro.en: Instrument and sensor harnesses connect sensing elements, transmitters, gauges, acquisition modules and controllers. They may carry low-level analog signals, digital communication, excitation power or mixed circuits.
intro.zh: 仪表与传感器线束连接传感元件、变送器、仪表、采集模块和控制器，可能承载低电平模拟信号、数字通信、激励电源或混合回路。

knowledge.en: Signal type determines whether twisted pairs, shielding, drain wires or controlled grounding are needed. Shield termination, reference ground and separation from noisy power circuits must follow the equipment design rather than a generic rule.
knowledge.zh: 信号类型决定是否需要双绞、屏蔽、排流线或特定接地方式。屏蔽端接、参考地以及与干扰性动力回路的间距，应依据设备设计确定，不能套用单一规则。

notes.en: Provide the sensor and controller models, signal type, pin definition, supply voltage, connector orientation, required shielding and installation environment. For calibrated systems, define which calibration or functional checks remain the customer's responsibility.
notes.zh: 需要提供传感器与控制器型号、信号类型、针脚定义、供电电压、接口方向、屏蔽要求和安装环境；涉及校准的系统，还应明确哪些校准或功能验证由客户完成。

delivery.en: Pin routing, conductor and shield construction are reviewed before sampling. Continuity, insulation where specified, shield termination and labels are checked to the approved drawing; signal performance testing is agreed separately when required.
delivery.zh: 打样前审核针脚路径、导体与屏蔽结构；依据确认图纸检查导通、约定的绝缘项目、屏蔽端接和标签，若需要信号性能测试则另行约定。

subtitle.en: From the sensing point to the acquisition system
subtitle.zh: 从感知端到采集系统的完整连接

lead.en: Instrument and sensor harness is a broad product family rather than one universal lead. It includes compact internal jumpers, shielded analog cables, thermocouple and RTD extensions, transmitter leads, encoder branches and multi-channel acquisition looms. Each assembly is developed around the real sensor, instrument, signal type, connector and installation environment.
lead.zh: 仪表与传感器线束不是一种通用线缆，而是覆盖机内短跳线、屏蔽模拟量线、热电偶与RTD延长线、变送器连接线、编码器分支和多通道采集线束的一整类产品。每一款都需要围绕真实传感器、仪表、信号类型、接口和安装环境开发。

advantages.zh: 仪表与传感器线束类型

method.en: Instrument and Sensor Harness Making Method
method.zh: 仪表与传感器线束制作方法

title.zh: 模拟量传感器与变送器线束

copy.en: Connects voltage, current-loop, bridge or other defined analog signals between sensing elements, transmitters, displays and acquisition modules.
copy.zh: 连接电压、电流环、电桥或其他已定义模拟信号，用于传感元件、变送器、显示仪表与采集模块之间的互连。

copy.en: Conductor and extension-wire type, polarity, junction treatment, connector and ambient temperature are kept consistent with the measurement system.
copy.zh: 导体与补偿线类型、极性、接点处理、接口和环境温度需与测量系统保持一致。

title.zh: 数字传感器与现场总线线束

copy.en: Supports defined interfaces such as encoder, serial, CAN or industrial communication circuits with the required pair structure, shielding and pin map.
copy.zh: 按项目支持编码器、串行、CAN或工业通信回路，并匹配所需线对结构、屏蔽与针脚定义。

title.zh: 密封型现场传感器线束

copy.en: Combines compatible housings, terminals, seals, cable diameter and branch protection for sensors exposed to splash, dust, oil or outdoor mounting.
copy.zh: 针对飞溅、粉尘、油污或户外安装环境，组合兼容的壳体、端子、密封件、线径与分支防护。

title.zh: 面板仪表与指示器线束

copy.en: Organizes power, signal, alarm and communication links behind panels where orientation, service access and installation order are constrained.
copy.zh: 在面板背部空间受限的环境中整理供电、信号、报警和通信连接，并兼顾接口方向、检修空间与装配顺序。

copy.en: Routes multiple sensing channels to DAQ, I/O or test systems with defined channel labels, breakout positions, reference conductors and shield treatment.
copy.zh: 将多路传感通道连接至DAQ、I/O或测试系统，并明确通道标签、分线位置、参考导体和屏蔽处理。

copy.en: Wire size, strand construction, pair twist and resistance are selected from signal level, distance, flexing, termination and system requirements.
copy.zh: 根据信号电平、距离、弯曲工况、端接方式与系统要求选择线径、绞合结构、线对节距和电阻特性。

title.en: Shield, drain wire and reference ground

copy.en: Foil, braid, drain wire and termination method are defined with the controller grounding architecture; shielding is not added or grounded by appearance alone.
copy.zh: 铝箔、编织、排流线与端接方式需要配合控制器接地架构定义，不能只凭外观决定是否增加或连接屏蔽。

copy.en: Insulation, jacket, sleeve, conduit or braid are reviewed against temperature, oil, abrasion, chemicals, installation space and movement.
copy.zh: 绝缘、护套、套管、波纹管或编织层需结合温度、油污、磨损、化学环境、安装空间与运动条件审核。

title.zh: 连接器、端子与传感器接口

copy.en: Housing family, keying, terminal, plating, seal, sensor-side interface and mating orientation are confirmed as one compatible connection system.
copy.zh: 壳体系列、防错、端子、镀层、密封件、传感器端接口与对插方向需作为一个兼容系统共同确认。

title.en: Build from sensor and instrument data
title.zh: 依据传感器与仪表资料开发

copy.en: Model numbers, manuals, pin tables, signal type, supply, measurement range and connector drawings are converted into a reviewed interconnect definition.
copy.zh: 把型号、手册、针脚表、信号类型、供电、测量范围和接口图转化为经过审核的互连定义。

title.en: Match an existing cable or sample

copy.en: A sample can establish dimensions, visible construction and mating interfaces, while hidden circuits, compensation materials and calibration responsibility still require confirmation.
copy.zh: 样品可用于确认尺寸、可见结构和对插接口，但隐藏回路、补偿材料与校准责任仍需另行确认。

title.zh: 将敏感信号与动力回路分开

copy.en: Routing, spacing, pair layout, shield termination and branch points are coordinated with the machine to reduce avoidable coupling into low-level circuits.
copy.zh: 结合设备协调路径、间距、线对布局、屏蔽端接和分支点，减少动力回路对低电平信号的不必要耦合。

title.zh: 处理停产或难采购接口

copy.en: Alternative parts are compared by mating compatibility, terminal system, electrical rating, sealing, material and documented approval rather than appearance.
copy.zh: 替代件按对插兼容、端子系统、电气额定、密封、材料与书面批准进行比较，不只比外观。

copy.en: Bench instruments, DAQ modules, test fixtures, reference sensors and replaceable test leads.
copy.zh: 台式仪表、DAQ采集模块、测试工装、参考传感器和可更换测试线。

copy.en: Photoelectric, proximity, temperature, pressure, position and weighing sensors distributed across a production machine.
copy.zh: 分布在生产设备中的光电、接近、温度、压力、位置和称重传感器。

title.zh: 水处理、能源与环境监测

copy.en: Level, flow, pressure, conductivity and condition-monitoring instruments installed around pumps, tanks and treatment systems.
copy.zh: 安装在泵、储罐与处理系统周围的液位、流量、压力、电导率及状态监测仪表。

copy.en: Encoders, limit sensors, tool probes, temperature points and condition-monitoring devices inside machines.
copy.zh: 机床内部的编码器、限位传感器、对刀探头、温度测点与状态监测装置。

copy.en: Internal sensor interconnects, pumps, valves, detectors, acquisition boards and front-panel instruments.
copy.zh: 连接内部传感器、泵、阀、检测器、采集板与前面板仪表。

copy.en: Position, force, vision-trigger, safety and process sensors linked to local I/O and controllers.
copy.zh: 将位置、力、视觉触发、安全与工艺传感器连接至现场I/O和控制器。

copy.en: Confirm sensor, instrument, signal type, supply, pin map, mating interface, route and environment.
copy.zh: 确认传感器、仪表、信号类型、供电、针脚、对插接口、路径和环境。

copy.en: Define conductor, pair, shield, ground, protection, branch datum, labels and connector direction.
copy.zh: 定义导体、线对、屏蔽、接地、防护、分支基准、标签与接口方向。

copy.en: Verify wire, connector, terminal, seal, sleeve, label and any approved alternative before build.
copy.zh: 制作前核对线材、连接器、端子、密封、套管、标签及认可替代。

copy.en: Cut, strip, terminate, assemble, shield, protect and form the harness to the reviewed documents.
copy.zh: 依据审核文件完成下线、剥线、端接、组装、屏蔽、防护与成型。

copy.en: Check circuit mapping, continuity, polarity, isolation and shield termination according to the approved plan.
copy.zh: 按批准计划检查回路对应、导通、极性、隔离与屏蔽端接。

copy.en: Fit, signal behavior, calibration or functional checks are completed on an agreed setup with responsibilities recorded.
copy.zh: 在约定装置上完成装配、信号表现、校准或功能验证，并记录责任边界。

copy.en: The harness is reviewed as part of the complete sensor-to-instrument chain; cable construction alone cannot guarantee measurement performance.
copy.zh: 把线束作为传感器至仪表完整测量链路的一部分审核，不能只凭线缆结构保证测量性能。

copy.en: Power separation, reference ground and shield termination follow the controller and installation architecture, with any performance test agreed by project.
copy.zh: 动力隔离、参考地与屏蔽端接需服从控制器和安装架构，性能测试方法按项目约定。

copy.en: Thermocouple or temperature-measurement circuits require the specified conductor or extension type, polarity and junction treatment across the expected environment.
copy.zh: 热电偶或温度测量回路需要在预期环境中保持指定导体或补偿类型、极性与接点处理。

copy.en: Clamp spacing, service loop, sleeve, backshell and strain relief are reviewed to keep repeated mechanical load away from terminals and sensor exits.
copy.zh: 审核固定间距、检修余量、套管、尾附件与应力防护，减少端子和传感器出线处的重复机械载荷。

copy.en: Defined labels, colors, breakouts and connector directions help installation and troubleshooting follow the approved channel map.
copy.zh: 明确标签、颜色、分线与接口方向，使安装和排查能够依据已批准通道表进行。

copy.en: Service loops and replaceable interface sections can shorten access work without disturbing unrelated sensing channels.
copy.zh: 检修余量和可更换接口段可减少拆装工作，并避免扰动无关传感通道。

copy.en: An approved pin map, material list, shield treatment and inspection plan are carried into later production batches.
copy.zh: 把已批准针脚表、物料清单、屏蔽处理和检验计划延续到后续生产批次。

title.en: A harness matched to the instrument system

copy.en: Sensor function, signal path, environment, installation and validation responsibility are handled as one project instead of adapting a generic cable.
copy.zh: 把传感功能、信号路径、环境、安装与验证责任作为一个项目处理，而不是勉强套用通用线缆。

q.en: Is an instrument and sensor harness a fixed product model?
q.zh: 仪表与传感器线束是固定型号吗？

a.en: No. It is a family covering many sensors, instruments, signal types, interfaces and environments. The final harness is defined by the actual measurement system.
a.zh: 不是。它覆盖多种传感器、仪表、信号类型、接口与环境，最终结构由真实测量系统定义。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide sensor and instrument models, manuals or drawings, signal type, supply, pin map, connector data, route, length, environment, quantity and required inspections.
a.zh: 建议提供传感器与仪表型号、手册或图纸、信号类型、供电、针脚表、接口资料、路径、长度、环境、数量和检验要求。

q.en: Can you copy an existing sensor cable?
q.zh: 可以按现有传感器线缆复制吗？

a.en: A sample can define dimensions and visible construction, but signal function, hidden components, compensation material and calibration responsibility must still be confirmed.
a.zh: 样品可用于确认尺寸和可见结构，但信号功能、隐藏元件、补偿材料与校准责任仍需确认。

q.en: Does every sensor cable need shielding?
q.zh: 所有传感器线缆都需要屏蔽吗？

a.en: No. The need and termination method depend on signal level, interface, cable length, surrounding circuits, grounding architecture and equipment documentation.
a.zh: 不一定。是否需要以及如何端接，取决于信号电平、接口、线长、周边回路、接地架构与设备资料。

q.en: Can thermocouple extension wire be replaced by ordinary copper wire?
q.zh: 热电偶延长线可以用普通铜线替代吗？

a.en: Not without system review. Thermocouple circuits may require a specified extension or compensating conductor type and correct polarity across the measurement chain.
a.zh: 不能未经审核直接替代。热电偶回路可能要求指定延长或补偿导体类型，并在测量链路中保持正确极性。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection. Pin mapping, polarity, insulation, shield termination, dimensions or signal-related checks are added when defined in the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查；针脚对应、极性、绝缘、屏蔽端接、尺寸或信号相关项目按已批准项目计划增加。

intro.en: Appliance harnesses distribute power and control signals among switches, heaters, motors, sensors, displays and control boards inside electrical equipment. Space, heat sources and assembly sequence strongly influence the design.
intro.zh: 电器设备线束在开关、加热器、电机、传感器、显示器和控制板之间分配电源与控制信号。内部空间、热源位置和装配顺序会明显影响结构。

knowledge.en: Conductor size, insulation, terminals and protection are selected from the actual current, temperature, movement and applicable product requirements. Routing near sharp edges or heat sources may require clips, sleeves, grommets or additional separation.
knowledge.zh: 导体规格、绝缘、端子和防护方式需要根据实际电流、温度、运动情况及适用产品要求确定。靠近锐边或热源的布线可能需要卡扣、套管、护线圈或额外隔离。

notes.en: Provide the appliance model or internal layout, circuit diagram, component interfaces, current and temperature information, assembly sequence and required standard or document. A category listing does not replace project-specific safety or compliance review.
notes.zh: 建议提供设备型号或内部布局、电路图、器件接口、电流与温度信息、装配顺序以及适用标准或文件。页面中的类别名称不能代替具体项目的安全与合规审核。

delivery.en: The engineering sample confirms fit, routing, terminal retention, labels and assembly sequence. Agreed electrical checks and workmanship criteria are recorded before repeat orders.
delivery.zh: 工程样品用于确认装配适配、布线、端子保持、标签和安装顺序；约定的电气检查与工艺验收标准会在重复订单前记录确认。

subtitle.en: Power, control and sensing connections inside electrical equipment
subtitle.zh: 连接电器内部的电源、控制与感知回路

lead.en: An appliance harness is not one standard cable. It is a broad family covering internal power leads, heater circuits, motor and compressor branches, sensor and switch wiring, display connections and compact multi-branch looms. The finished assembly is developed around the actual appliance architecture, current, temperature zones, component interfaces, installation path and production sequence.
lead.zh: 电器设备线束不是某一种标准线缆，而是一整类覆盖内部电源线、加热回路、电机与压缩机分支、传感器与开关连接、显示板连接以及紧凑型多分支线束的产品。成品需要围绕真实设备架构、电流、温区、器件接口、安装路径和生产顺序开发。

method.zh: 电器设备线束制作方法

copy.en: Connects the main PCB, relay board, display, keypad and local modules with defined pin routing, connector orientation, service loops and assembly order.
copy.zh: 连接主控板、继电器板、显示器、按键和局部模块，并明确针脚路径、接口方向、检修余量与装配顺序。

copy.en: Routes power and temperature-control circuits around heaters, thermostats, thermal cutoffs and temperature sensors while keeping insulation and terminals suitable for the actual heat zone.
copy.zh: 在加热器、温控器、热熔断器和温度传感器之间连接电源与温控回路，并让绝缘与端子适配真实热区。

title.zh: 电机、风机与压缩机线束

copy.en: Combines motor power, start or run components, feedback, overload protection and grounding connections for fans, pumps, compressors and drive modules.
copy.zh: 为风机、泵、压缩机和驱动模块组合电机电源、启动或运行元件、反馈、过载保护与接地连接。

title.zh: 传感器、开关与联锁线束

copy.en: Links door switches, level devices, flow sensors, pressure switches, limit contacts and safety interlocks with clear branch identification and protected routing.
copy.zh: 连接门开关、液位器件、流量传感器、压力开关、限位触点与安全联锁，并保持分支识别清楚、路径受保护。

copy.en: Provides compact power, communication and key-scan connections between displays, touch panels, indicator boards and the main controller in restricted front-panel spaces.
copy.zh: 在受限前面板空间中连接显示器、触控板、指示板与主控制器的供电、通信和按键扫描回路。

title.zh: 紧凑型多分支内部线束

copy.en: Organizes many short internal circuits into a formed loom whose branch points, clips, labels and connector directions match the appliance assembly sequence.
copy.zh: 把多条短距离内部回路整理成成型线束，使分支点、卡扣、标签和接口方向匹配设备装配顺序。

copy.en: Conductor size is selected from current, voltage drop, duty cycle, ambient temperature, bundling, terminal range and applicable equipment documentation. Fine-strand or other constructions are used only when movement and termination requirements justify them.
copy.zh: 导体规格需要结合电流、压降、工作周期、环境温度、成束状态、端子范围与适用设备文件确定。细绞或其他结构仅在运动与端接要求确有需要时采用。

title.en: Insulation for normal and heated zones

copy.en: PVC, XLPE, silicone, fluoropolymer or another specified insulation is reviewed against conductor temperature, nearby heat sources, flexing, moisture, chemicals and required flame behavior. One harness may contain more than one insulation system.
copy.zh: PVC、XLPE、硅胶、氟塑料或其他指定绝缘，需要结合导体温度、邻近热源、弯曲、湿气、化学环境与阻燃要求审核。同一线束可能同时使用多种绝缘体系。

copy.en: Terminal family, wire range, plating, housing keying, locking feature and mating component are treated as one connection system. Tabs, receptacles, ring terminals, board connectors and sealed interfaces are chosen from the real appliance layout.
copy.zh: 端子系列、适配线径、镀层、壳体防错、锁止结构与对插件需要作为一个连接系统审核。插片、插簧、环形端子、板端连接器和密封接口均按真实设备布局选择。

title.zh: 套管、卡扣、护线圈与标识

copy.en: Heat-resistant sleeves, corrugated tube, braid, edge grommets, clips, ties and labels keep circuits away from heat, sharp sheet metal, moving parts and service access. Protection is placed according to the installation path rather than added as decoration.
copy.zh: 耐热套管、波纹管、编织层、护线圈、卡扣、扎带和标签用于避开热源、钣金锐边、运动部件和检修区域。防护应依据安装路径设置，不是为了外观随意增加。

title.en: Build from drawings and appliance layout
title.zh: 依据图纸与设备布局开发

copy.en: Circuit diagrams, pin tables, board drawings, component specifications and installation views are converted into a reviewed harness drawing with branch datums, lengths, interfaces, labels and inspection points.
copy.zh: 把电路图、针脚表、板卡图、器件规格和安装视图转化为经过审核的线束图纸，明确分支基准、长度、接口、标签与检验点。

title.en: Develop from an appliance or reference sample
title.zh: 依据设备或参考样品开发

copy.en: An appliance or existing loom can establish fit, route and visible interfaces. Hidden circuits, current, temperature rating, safety parts and acceptance requirements still need customer confirmation before replication.
copy.zh: 设备实物或现有线束可以帮助确认装配、路径和可见接口，但隐藏回路、电流、温度等级、安全件和验收要求仍需客户确认后才能复制。

title.en: Separate power, heat and sensitive control circuits
title.zh: 区分动力、热区与敏感控制回路

copy.en: Branch layout, spacing, sleeves, routing and connector grouping are coordinated so higher-current or heated circuits do not create avoidable risk for low-level sensing and communication paths.
copy.zh: 协调分支布局、间距、套管、路径和接口分组，避免较大电流或热区回路给低电平感知与通信路径带来不必要风险。

title.zh: 审核替代件与难采购器件

copy.en: When an original connector, terminal or protection part is unavailable, alternatives are compared by mating fit, electrical rating, material, temperature, locking, approval documents and installation impact. Appearance alone is not enough.
copy.zh: 原连接器、端子或防护件难以采购时，应从对插、电气额定、材料、温度、锁止、认可文件和安装影响等方面比较替代件，不能只看外观。

copy.en: Ovens, cookers, coffee equipment, water heaters and warming devices with heaters, thermostats, thermal protection, pumps and control boards.
copy.zh: 烤箱、炊具、咖啡设备、热水设备与保温装置，内部包含加热器、温控、热保护、泵和控制板。

copy.en: Washing machines, dryers, refrigerators and freezers using motors, valves, pumps, compressors, fans, sensors, door switches and displays.
copy.zh: 洗衣机、干衣机、冰箱与冷柜，连接电机、阀、泵、压缩机、风机、传感器、门开关与显示器。

copy.en: Air handlers, fan coils, ventilation units, dehumidifiers and climate-control equipment with blowers, dampers, sensors and control modules.
copy.zh: 空气处理机、风机盘管、通风设备、除湿机与温控设备，连接风机、风阀、传感器和控制模块。

copy.en: Water dispensers, beverage machines, pumps and treatment appliances with level, flow, pressure, heating and valve-control circuits.
copy.zh: 饮水设备、饮料机、泵和处理电器，内部包含液位、流量、压力、加热与阀控制回路。

copy.en: Vending machines, food-service equipment, commercial dryers and unattended devices requiring organized branches, replaceable modules and clear service identification.
copy.zh: 自动售卖机、餐饮设备、商用干燥设备与无人值守装置，需要有序分支、可更换模块和清晰检修标识。

title.zh: 紧凑型电器与办公设备

copy.en: Printers, purifiers, small fans, countertop devices and compact electronics where connector direction, bend radius and internal space are tightly constrained.
copy.zh: 打印设备、净化设备、小型风机、台面电器和紧凑型电子设备，其接口方向、弯曲半径和内部空间通常受到严格限制。

copy.en: Confirm the appliance architecture, circuit diagram, component interfaces, loads, temperature zones, route, assembly order, quantity and required documents.
copy.zh: 确认设备架构、电路图、器件接口、负载、温区、路径、装配顺序、数量和所需文件。

copy.en: Define conductors, insulation, terminals, housings, branch datums, protection, clips, labels and any customer-approved alternatives.
copy.zh: 定义导体、绝缘、端子、壳体、分支基准、防护、卡扣、标签和客户认可替代。

copy.en: Build an engineering sample and check connector direction, branch position, service loop, route, clips and access against the actual appliance or agreed fixture.
copy.zh: 制作工程样品，并在真实设备或约定工装上核对接口方向、分支位置、检修余量、路径、卡扣与操作空间。

copy.en: Cut, strip, crimp or otherwise terminate, insert, splice, sleeve, label and form the harness to the controlled work documents.
copy.zh: 依据受控作业文件完成下线、剥线、压接或其他端接、插壳、接点、套管、标签与成型。

copy.en: Check circuit mapping, continuity, polarity, terminal insertion, retention, dimensions, labels and appearance. Insulation or other electrical tests are added when the approved plan requires them.
copy.zh: 检查回路对应、导通、极性、端子插入、保持、尺寸、标签与外观。绝缘或其他电气项目按批准计划增加。

copy.en: After the first article is approved, drawing, BOM, work instructions, fixtures and inspection points are recorded so later batches reproduce the confirmed configuration.
copy.zh: 首件确认后记录图纸、BOM、作业指导、工装与检验点，使后续批次复现已确认配置。

copy.en: Wire insulation, terminals, sleeves, spacing and attachment are reviewed against normal operating temperature, nearby heaters and defined abnormal conditions. The complete appliance safety assessment remains project-specific.
copy.zh: 结合正常工作温度、邻近热源与已定义异常工况审核线材绝缘、端子、套管、间距和固定。完整设备安全评估仍需按项目执行。

title.en: Current, voltage drop and terminal retention

copy.en: Conductor size, branch loading, connection resistance, crimp geometry and terminal retention are coordinated for motors, heaters, compressors and other higher-load circuits.
copy.zh: 针对电机、加热器、压缩机等较高负载回路，协调导体规格、分支负载、连接电阻、压接几何和端子保持。

title.en: Vibration, sharp edges and strain relief

copy.en: Clips, grommets, sleeves, service loops and branch positions keep repeated load away from terminals and prevent contact with sheet-metal edges, fans and moving mechanisms.
copy.zh: 通过卡扣、护线圈、套管、检修余量与分支位置，减少端子处重复载荷，并避免接触钣金锐边、风机和运动机构。

copy.en: Continuity and appearance inspection are standard finished-harness checks. Temperature, flame, dielectric, endurance or complete-appliance compliance claims require agreed materials, methods, samples and responsible laboratories.
copy.zh: 导通与外观属于成品线束常规检查。温度、阻燃、耐压、寿命或整机合规结论，需要约定材料、方法、样品与责任实验室后执行。

copy.en: Defined branches, labels, connector directions and clips reduce routing decisions on the assembly line and help operators install the loom in the intended sequence.
copy.zh: 明确分支、标签、接口方向和卡扣，减少装配线上临时判断，使操作人员按照预定顺序安装线束。

copy.en: Service loops, separable sections and readable identification help technicians reach replaceable modules without disturbing unrelated circuits.
copy.zh: 检修余量、可分离线段与清晰标识，帮助技术人员接近可更换模块，减少对无关回路的扰动。

copy.en: An approved drawing, BOM, branch fixture and inspection plan carry the confirmed assembly into repeat orders and controlled revisions.
copy.zh: 通过已批准图纸、BOM、分支工装与检验计划，把确认样品延续到重复订单和受控版本变更。

title.en: A harness matched to the actual appliance

copy.en: Electrical load, heat, component interfaces, enclosure space, routing and installation are handled as one project instead of forcing a generic loom into the product.
copy.zh: 把电气负载、热环境、器件接口、壳体空间、路径和安装作为一个项目处理，而不是把通用线束勉强塞进产品。

q.en: Is an appliance harness a fixed product model?
q.zh: 电器设备线束是固定型号吗？

a.en: No. It is a broad family covering different appliances, loads, temperature zones, connectors, branches and assembly methods. The final harness is defined by the actual appliance and approved documents.
a.zh: 不是。它覆盖不同电器、负载、温区、接口、分支与装配方式，最终结构由真实设备和批准文件确定。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide the circuit diagram or pin table, appliance layout, component and mating-interface data, current and temperature information, branch dimensions, assembly restrictions, quantity and required inspections. A physical sample can supplement incomplete drawings.
a.zh: 建议提供电路图或针脚表、设备布局、器件与对插资料、电流和温度信息、分支尺寸、装配限制、数量与检验要求。图纸不完整时可补充实物样品。

q.en: Can you reproduce an existing appliance harness from a sample?
q.zh: 可以按现有电器线束样品复制吗？

a.en: A sample can define visible materials, dimensions and interfaces, but hidden circuits, conductor ratings, safety components and acceptance criteria still require confirmation before production.
a.zh: 样品可以用于确认可见材料、尺寸和接口，但隐藏回路、导体额定、安全件与验收标准仍需在生产前确认。

q.en: Which insulation material should be used near a heater?
q.zh: 靠近加热器应该使用哪种绝缘材料？

a.en: There is no universal answer. Selection depends on conductor temperature, distance from the heat source, exposure time, current, movement, surrounding materials and applicable appliance requirements. The complete thermal zone must be reviewed.
a.zh: 没有通用答案。需要结合导体温度、与热源距离、暴露时间、电流、运动、周边材料和适用设备要求选择，并审核完整热区。

q.en: Can connector or terminal substitutions be accepted?
q.zh: 连接器或端子可以替代吗？

a.en: Only after review and approval. Mating fit, terminal system, wire range, current, temperature, plating, locking, material and relevant documents must be compared before an alternative is released.
a.zh: 必须经过审核与批准。替代放行前需要比较对插、端子系统、适配线径、电流、温度、镀层、锁止、材料与相关文件。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection. Circuit mapping, polarity, terminal retention, dimensions, labels, insulation or other electrical and mechanical checks are added according to the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品线束进行导通与外观检查。回路对应、极性、端子保持、尺寸、标签、绝缘或其他电气与机械项目按已批准项目计划增加。

intro.en: Jumper harnesses are short interconnects used between boards, modules, terminal points or adjacent devices. Their simple appearance can hide different pin routes, orientation and current requirements.
intro.zh: 跳线线束通常用于电路板、模块、端子点或相邻设备之间的短距离连接。外观虽然简单，但针脚路径、方向和电流要求可能完全不同。

knowledge.en: A jumper may be straight-through, crossed, split or combined with specified components. Connector pitch, keying, terminal plating, conductor size and pull direction affect compatibility.
knowledge.zh: 跳线可能是直通、交叉、分支，也可能按要求集成指定元件。接口间距、防错结构、端子镀层、导体规格和受力方向都会影响兼容性。

notes.en: Confirm both mating interfaces, pin-to-pin table, insertion direction, length reference, current or signal function and whether a sample must be matched. Do not infer a straight-through connection from the connector count.
notes.zh: 需要确认两端对插接口、针脚对应表、插入方向、长度基准、电流或信号功能以及是否需要匹配样品，不能因为两端芯数相同就默认直通。

delivery.en: A first article is built to the approved pin table and dimensional reference. Continuity, polarity where applicable, terminal retention and appearance are checked before the batch is released.
delivery.zh: 首件依据确认的针脚表和尺寸基准制作，并检查导通、适用时的极性、端子保持与外观，确认后再放行批量生产。

subtitle.en: Short interconnections with exact pin routing
subtitle.zh: 短距离连接，也需要精确的针脚定义

lead.en: A jumper harness may be only a few centimetres long, but it is not a generic patch lead. This category includes board-to-board jumpers, terminal jumpers, adapter leads, crossed pin routes, split circuits, service links and short power or signal looms. The correct result depends on both mating interfaces, pin mapping, current or signal function, insertion direction, length datum and the way the jumper is installed and serviced.
lead.zh: 跳线线束可能只有几厘米长，但它不是随手拼接的通用连接线。这个小类包含板对板跳线、端子跳线、转接线、交叉针脚线、分支回路、检修连接线以及短距离电源或信号线束。最终结构取决于两端对插接口、针脚对应、电流或信号功能、插入方向、长度基准以及实际安装与检修方式。

copy.en: Short multi-core links between a main PCB, display, relay board, sensor module or daughterboard. Connector pitch, keying, pin numbering, insertion direction and bend space must match both ends.
copy.zh: 用于主板、显示板、继电器板、传感模块或子板之间的短距离多芯连接，需要同时匹配两端的接口间距、防错、针脚编号、插入方向与弯曲空间。

copy.en: Pre-cut links for adjacent or repeated terminal points, switches, breakers and panel devices. Length, ferrules or terminals, colour and numbering are coordinated with the panel layout.
copy.zh: 用于相邻或重复端子点、开关、断路器和面板器件的预制连接，长度、冷压端头或端子、颜色与线号需要配合面板布局。

copy.en: Converts one connector family, pitch or contact arrangement to another without changing the required electrical function. Both mating part numbers and a confirmed pin table are essential.
copy.zh: 在不改变所需电气功能的前提下，把一种连接器系列、间距或触点排列转接到另一种接口。必须明确两端对插件型号和经过确认的针脚表。

copy.en: Equal contact counts do not guarantee straight-through wiring. Crossed pairs, reversed orientation, keyed housings, polarity and shield or drain positions are documented circuit by circuit.
copy.zh: 两端芯数相同并不代表一定直通。交叉线对、反向插入、防错壳体、极性以及屏蔽或排流线位置，都需要逐回路记录。

copy.en: Connects power entry, fuse, relay, terminal point and local load over a short path. Conductor size, terminal rating, branch loading, voltage drop and protection coordination are reviewed together.
copy.zh: 在短路径内连接电源入口、保险、继电器、端子点与局部负载，需要同时审核导体规格、端子额定、分支负载、压降与保护配合。

copy.en: Used for maintenance access, temporary test connection, module replacement or retrofit work. Clear labels, protected contacts and controlled compatibility help prevent an incorrect connection during service.
copy.zh: 用于检修接入、临时测试、模块替换或改造项目。清晰标签、触点防护与受控兼容关系，可以降低维修时误插误接的风险。

copy.en: Wire size and strand construction are selected from circuit current, voltage drop, flexibility, terminal range and route. PVC, XLPE, silicone, fluoropolymer or another specified insulation is reviewed against temperature, chemicals, movement and applicable equipment documents.
copy.zh: 线径与绞合结构依据回路电流、压降、柔性、端子范围与路径选择。PVC、XLPE、硅胶、氟塑料或其他指定绝缘，需要结合温度、化学环境、运动与适用设备文件审核。

title.en: Connector pitch, keying and housing material
title.zh: 接口间距、防错与壳体材料

copy.en: A visually similar housing may have a different pitch, latch, polarization, cavity numbering or resin grade. Original part numbers, mating samples or verified drawings reduce the risk of a jumper that looks correct but cannot mate.
copy.zh: 外观相似的壳体可能具有不同间距、锁扣、极化方向、孔位编号或树脂等级。原型号、对插样品或已核实图纸，可以降低跳线外观正确却无法对插的风险。

copy.en: Contact plating, compatible wire range, seal range, strip length, crimp tooling and retention feature belong to one termination system. Ring, fork, blade, receptacle, ferrule and connector contacts are not selected by appearance alone.
copy.zh: 触点镀层、适配线径、密封范围、剥线长度、压接工装和保持结构属于同一端接系统。环形、叉形、片式、插簧、冷压端头与连接器端子不能只看外观选择。

copy.en: Heat-shrink, braid, small conduit, terminal boots, cavity plugs and durable labels are added where the route or service method requires them. Exposed contacts and loose short leads need packaging and handling controls as well as electrical design.
copy.zh: 热缩管、编织层、小型套管、端子护套、堵孔件和耐久标签，应在路径或检修方式确有需要时使用。裸露触点和短小散线除了电气设计，还需要包装与搬运控制。

copy.en: The approved table records cavity numbers, wire colours, conductor sizes, circuit names, shields, polarity and any crossed route. The harness drawing adds length datums, connector views, labels and inspection points.
copy.zh: 批准的针脚表记录孔位、线色、导体规格、回路名称、屏蔽、极性与交叉路径；线束图纸再补充长度基准、接口视图、标签和检验点。

title.zh: 依据样品开发但不猜测

copy.en: A reference jumper helps confirm dimensions, connector orientation and visible materials. Hidden pin routes, ratings, plating, internal splices and acceptance requirements are verified separately before the sample is copied.
copy.zh: 参考样品可以帮助确认尺寸、接口方向与可见材料，但隐藏针脚路径、额定、镀层、内部接点和验收要求，需要单独核实后再复制。

copy.en: When two modules use different connector families, the jumper is designed as a controlled adapter. Pin function, signal pairing, grounding, shield continuity, voltage and current compatibility are reviewed before defining the mechanical conversion.
copy.zh: 两个模块采用不同连接器系列时，跳线应作为受控转接件开发。先审核针脚功能、信号配对、接地、屏蔽连续性、电压与电流兼容，再定义机械转接。

title.en: Turn a hand-built link into repeatable production
title.zh: 把手工连接转化为可重复生产

copy.en: A temporary field jumper can be converted into a drawing, BOM, controlled lengths, approved terminals, labels and an electrical test program. This creates a replaceable part instead of relying on technician memory.
copy.zh: 临时现场跳线可以转化为图纸、BOM、受控长度、认可端子、标签和电气测试程序，使其成为可替换零件，而不是依赖技术人员记忆。

copy.en: Short links between control boards, displays, motors, switches, sensors and local power points where enclosure space and assembly order are limited.
copy.zh: 连接控制板、显示器、电机、开关、传感器与局部电源点，适用于壳体空间和装配顺序受限的设备。

copy.en: Module jumpers, panel links and replacement adapters for sensors, relays, actuators, I/O points and machine subassemblies.
copy.zh: 用于传感器、继电器、执行器、I/O点和设备子组件的模块跳线、面板连接与替换转接。

copy.en: Defined patch leads and breakout jumpers for development benches, fixtures, measurement modules and engineering validation, with pin mapping that can be reproduced later.
copy.zh: 为开发台、工装、测量模块与工程验证提供受控连接线和引出跳线，并保留可复现的针脚定义。

copy.en: Pre-terminated jumpers between terminal blocks, breakers, relays, switches, door components and cabinet modules, prepared to the panel numbering and routing plan.
copy.zh: 按照面板编号和路径计划，预制端子排、断路器、继电器、开关、柜门器件与柜内模块之间的跳线。

copy.en: Low-level signal, excitation, communication and local power jumpers between instruments, acquisition boards, sensor interfaces and internal modules.
copy.zh: 连接仪器、采集板、传感接口与内部模块的低电平信号、激励、通信和局部电源跳线。

copy.en: Adapter and service jumpers that bridge an available replacement module to an existing machine interface while keeping the approved electrical function traceable.
copy.zh: 用转接或检修跳线把可获得的替换模块接入现有设备接口，同时保持已确认电气功能可追踪。

copy.en: Confirm both mating connector systems, circuit function, voltage, current, signal type, environment, quantity and required records before selecting materials.
copy.zh: 选料前确认两端对插系统、回路功能、电压、电流、信号类型、环境、数量与所需记录。

copy.en: Record cavity-to-cavity routing, connector views, insertion direction, length reference, exposed lead length, bend direction, labels and any straight, crossed or split circuit.
copy.zh: 记录孔位对应、接口视图、插入方向、长度基准、露线长度、弯曲方向、标签以及直通、交叉或分支回路。

copy.en: Prepare conductors to controlled cut and strip lengths, then crimp, solder or otherwise terminate with the approved contact system and tooling.
copy.zh: 按照受控下线与剥线长度准备导体，再使用认可触点系统和工装完成压接、焊接或其他端接。

copy.en: Insert contacts into the correct cavities, set connector orientation, form the short lead without overstressing the wire exit, and apply circuit or part identification.
copy.zh: 把端子插入正确孔位，设定接口方向，在不让出线位置过度受力的前提下完成短线成型，并增加回路或零件标识。

copy.en: Verify the approved pin map, opens, shorts, polarity where applicable, terminal seating, retention, dimensions and visible workmanship before release.
copy.zh: 放行前核对批准针脚表、断路、短路、适用时的极性、端子到位与保持、尺寸和可见工艺。

title.en: First article and controlled batch release

copy.en: The approved sample, drawing, BOM, test program and packaging method become the production reference. Later connector or pin changes are handled as recorded revisions.
copy.zh: 确认样品、图纸、BOM、测试程序与包装方式共同成为生产基准；后续接口或针脚变化通过受控版本处理。

title.en: Wire exit, bend radius and pull direction
title.zh: 出线、弯曲半径与受力方向

copy.en: A short jumper can transfer installation force directly into a terminal. Length, service loop, bend direction, strain relief and pull path are reviewed so the contact is not used as a mechanical anchor.
copy.zh: 短跳线容易把安装力直接传到端子。需要审核长度、余量、弯曲方向、应力防护与拉力路径，避免让触点承担机械固定作用。

title.en: Current, temperature rise and contact resistance

copy.en: Conductor size alone does not define capacity. Terminal family, crimp quality, connector rating, contact resistance, bundling, ambient temperature and duty cycle all affect a short power jumper.
copy.zh: 承载能力不能只看线径。端子系列、压接质量、接口额定、接触电阻、成束、环境温度与工作周期都会影响短距离电源跳线。

copy.en: Dust, moisture, oil, cleaning agents and handling can affect unsealed connectors and exposed terminals. Seals, boots, plugs, sleeves or packaging are specified only for the actual exposure.
copy.zh: 灰尘、湿气、油污、清洁剂和搬运可能影响非密封连接器与裸露端子。密封、护套、堵孔、套管或包装应针对真实暴露环境确定。

copy.en: Continuity confirms circuit routing but does not prove every signal, load or protocol is compatible. Functional, dielectric, insulation, temperature or endurance tests are added only when the project defines methods and acceptance limits.
copy.zh: 导通可以确认回路路径，但不能证明所有信号、负载或协议都兼容。功能、耐压、绝缘、温度或寿命测试，需要项目明确方法与限值后增加。

title.en: Faster installation with fewer wiring decisions
title.zh: 安装更快，现场判断更少

copy.en: Predefined length, connector orientation, pin map and labels remove repeated cutting and point-to-point decisions during equipment assembly or service.
copy.zh: 预先定义长度、接口方向、针脚和标签，减少设备装配或维修时反复下线与逐点判断。

copy.en: A drawing and test map make crossed routes, polarity, shields and special circuits visible to engineering, production and maintenance teams instead of hiding them inside a short cable.
copy.zh: 图纸和测试表让交叉路径、极性、屏蔽与特殊回路对工程、生产和维修团队可见，而不是隐藏在一根短线中。

copy.en: Controlled components, dimensions, labels and inspection records allow a service jumper or retrofit adapter to be reordered without rebuilding it from memory.
copy.zh: 受控器件、尺寸、标签与检验记录，使检修跳线或改造转接件可以重复订购，不必依靠记忆重新制作。

title.en: A small assembly treated as an engineered part
title.zh: 把小组件当作工程零件管理

copy.en: Even a two-wire link receives interface, circuit, material and acceptance definitions appropriate to its function, reducing the risk created by an undocumented improvised connection.
copy.zh: 即使只有两根线，也依据其功能定义接口、回路、材料和验收要求，降低无记录临时连接带来的风险。

q.en: Is a jumper harness always wired straight through?
q.zh: 跳线线束一定是直通的吗？

a.en: No. A jumper can be straight-through, crossed, reversed, split or combined with shields and specified components. The approved pin-to-pin table is the production and test reference.
a.zh: 不一定。跳线可以直通、交叉、反向、分支，也可能包含屏蔽或指定元件。批准的针脚对应表才是生产与测试依据。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both connector and mating part numbers, a pin table, circuit function, voltage and current, length datum, wire and colour requirements, environment, quantity and inspection requirements. Photos or samples can supplement missing drawings.
a.zh: 建议提供两端连接器及对插件型号、针脚表、回路功能、电压与电流、长度基准、线材与颜色要求、环境、数量和检验要求。照片或样品可以补充不完整的图纸。

q.en: Can a jumper be developed from an existing sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有样品开发跳线吗？

a.en: Yes, but a sample cannot reveal every rating or hidden circuit reliably. Pin mapping, conductor specification, terminal system, plating, polarity and acceptance criteria still need confirmation before repeat production.
a.zh: 可以，但样品不能可靠展示全部额定或隐藏回路。重复生产前仍需确认针脚、导体规格、端子系统、镀层、极性与验收标准。

q.en: How should jumper length be measured?
q.zh: 跳线长度应该怎样测量？

a.en: The drawing should define the datum, such as connector face to connector face, wire exit to wire exit or cut length. It should also state whether the jumper is straight, naturally laid or formed during measurement.
a.zh: 图纸应明确基准，例如接口端面到端面、出线口到出线口或下线长度，并说明测量时线束是拉直、自然放置还是已经成型。

q.en: Can a different connector replace the original one?
q.zh: 可以使用其他连接器替代原接口吗？

a.en: Only after reviewing mating fit, cavity numbering, terminal system, current, voltage, temperature, material, keying, locking and installation space. A similar shell shape is not evidence of compatibility.
a.zh: 必须审核对插、孔位编号、端子系统、电流、电压、温度、材料、防错、锁止与安装空间。壳体外观相似不能证明兼容。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished jumpers receive continuity and appearance inspection. Pin mapping, polarity, terminal retention, dimensions, labels, insulation or other electrical and mechanical checks are added according to the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品跳线进行导通与外观检查。针脚对应、极性、端子保持、尺寸、标签、绝缘或其他电气与机械项目按批准的项目计划增加。

intro.en: Pigtail and branch harnesses divide one main connection into multiple tails or provide a service lead from an existing circuit. Branch geometry and splice construction are central to the design.
intro.zh: 尾线与分支线束把一个主连接分成多个尾端，或从现有回路引出维修与功能支路。分支几何尺寸和接点结构是设计核心。

knowledge.en: Branch current, conductor combination, splice location, sealing and strain relief must be reviewed together. The joint method must suit the conductor construction and project acceptance criteria.
knowledge.zh: 分支电流、导体组合、接点位置、密封和应力防护需要一起审核。接点方式必须适配导体结构和项目验收标准。

notes.en: Provide a branch drawing with datum points, each tail length, conductor sizes, load information, mandatory splice method, sealing requirement and connector orientation. Clarify whether dimensions are measured before or after forming.
notes.zh: 应提供带基准点的分支图、各尾端长度、导体规格、负载信息、指定的接点方式、密封要求和接口方向，并明确尺寸是在成型前还是成型后测量。

delivery.en: The sample is checked on a branch board or dimensional template. Continuity, branch dimensions, splice protection, labels and mechanical checks are performed to the agreed project plan.
delivery.zh: 样品可在分支板或尺寸模板上核对；导通、分支尺寸、接点防护、标签以及机械项目按双方确认的项目计划执行。

subtitle.en: Connector tails, service leads and controlled branch geometry
subtitle.zh: 连接器尾线、检修引线与受控分支结构

lead.en: Pigtail and branch harnesses cover much more than a connector with loose wires. The category includes connector pigtails, open-ended service leads, Y branches, multi-drop looms, sealed sensor tails, repair adapters and power or signal breakouts. Each design must define pin mapping, branch current, splice construction, tail length, sealing, strain relief and the exact datum used to measure every leg.
lead.zh: 尾线与分支线束不只是连接器后面带几根散线。这个小类包括连接器尾线、开口检修引线、Y型分支、多路分配线束、密封传感器尾线、维修转接件以及电源或信号引出线。每种结构都需要明确针脚对应、分支电流、接点方式、尾端长度、密封、应力防护和各支路的尺寸基准。

copy.en: A defined connector and contact system on one end with stripped, tinned, crimped or unfinished leads on the other. Wire colour, cavity number, exposed length and end preparation are controlled for field termination.
copy.zh: 一端使用明确的连接器与端子系统，另一端为剥皮、浸锡、压接或未处理引线。线色、孔位、露线长度和尾端处理需要受控，便于现场端接。

copy.en: Short leads fitted with ring, fork, blade, receptacle or ferrule terminals for switches, studs, busbars and terminal blocks. Terminal size and bend direction follow the real fastening point.
copy.zh: 为开关、螺柱、母排与端子排预制环形、叉形、片式、插簧或冷压端头短线，端子规格和弯曲方向需要匹配真实固定点。

copy.en: One incoming circuit divides into two controlled tails. The joint location, combined conductor area, branch loading, protection and distance from the split to each connector are defined together.
copy.zh: 一个输入回路分成两条受控尾端。接点位置、导体组合、分支负载、防护方式以及分叉点到各接口的距离需要一起定义。

copy.en: Repeated connectors or devices are arranged along a main run for sensors, lights, valves or modules. Drop spacing, cumulative current, addressing and service replacement affect the layout.
copy.zh: 沿主干为传感器、灯具、阀或模块设置重复接口。支路间距、累计电流、寻址方式和检修替换都会影响布局。

title.zh: 板卡与传感器引出尾线

copy.en: Compact leads break a board connector into individual sensor, switch, power or communication tails. Pin function, signal pairing, shield handling and tight-space routing are recorded.
copy.zh: 把板端接口分解为独立传感器、开关、电源或通信尾线，需要记录针脚功能、信号配对、屏蔽处理和狭小空间路径。

copy.en: Replaces a damaged connector end or adapts an available component to an existing circuit without replacing the complete loom. Mating part, pin map and approved joining method remain traceable.
copy.zh: 在不更换整条主线束的情况下替换损坏接口，或把可获得器件接入现有回路。对插件、针脚表和认可接线方法必须可追踪。

copy.en: Main and branch wire sizes are selected from current, voltage drop, duty cycle, temperature, bundling and terminal range. A splice must accommodate the actual combined conductor area without cutting strands or leaving an unstable fill.
copy.zh: 主干与支路线径依据电流、压降、工作周期、温度、成束和端子范围选择。接点必须适配真实导体组合，避免伤丝或填充不稳定。

title.en: Splice sleeves, ferrules and joint systems
title.zh: 接点套筒、端头与连接系统

copy.en: Open-barrel splices, closed-end connectors, ferrules, ultrasonic welds, soldered joints or customer-specified methods are selected from conductor construction and acceptance requirements. Methods are not mixed casually.
copy.zh: 开口接点、闭端连接器、端头、超声波焊接、焊锡接点或客户指定方式，需要依据导体结构与验收要求选择，不能随意混用。

copy.en: PVC, XLPE, silicone, fluoropolymer, heat-shrink, adhesive sleeves, braid or conduit are reviewed against temperature, moisture, chemicals, abrasion and movement at the branch transition.
copy.zh: PVC、XLPE、硅胶、氟塑料、热缩管、带胶套管、编织层或波纹管，需要结合分支过渡处的温度、湿气、化学、磨损与运动审核。

title.zh: 连接器、端子、密封件与标签

copy.en: Housing keying, terminal plating, wire and seal range, cavity plugs, secondary locks and tail labels are treated as one interface system. Loose components are controlled by approved part numbers.
copy.zh: 壳体防错、端子镀层、适配线径与密封范围、堵孔件、二次锁和尾端标签，需要作为完整接口系统管理，散件由批准型号控制。

title.en: Develop from branch drawings and pin tables
title.zh: 依据分支图与针脚表开发

copy.en: The drawing defines a main datum, every branch length, connector view, cavity routing, splice position, protection and labels. Dimensions state whether the harness is straight, naturally laid or formed.
copy.zh: 图纸明确主基准、每条支路长度、接口视图、孔位路径、接点位置、防护和标签，并说明尺寸是在拉直、自然放置还是成型状态下测量。

title.en: Reverse an existing pigtail without hidden assumptions
title.zh: 依据样品开发但不保留隐藏假设

copy.en: A sample establishes visible dimensions and interfaces, while circuit function, ratings, internal joints, plating and sealing are verified separately. The result becomes a controlled part rather than an undocumented copy.
copy.zh: 样品用于确认可见尺寸和接口，回路功能、额定、内部接点、镀层与密封则单独核实，使结果成为受控零件，而不是无记录复制品。

title.zh: 制作便于维修的替换分支

copy.en: Damaged ends can be replaced with defined overlap, staggered joints, labels and protective sleeves. The repair position, access space and joint method are planned so the repaired section can be inspected and supported.
copy.zh: 损坏尾端可通过明确搭接、错位接点、标签和防护套管替换。维修位置、操作空间和接点方式需要提前规划，使修复段可以检查并获得支撑。

copy.en: For wet or outdoor routes, connector seals, individual wire seals, unused cavities, cable entry, joint encapsulation and branch strain relief are reviewed as one sealing stack.
copy.zh: 潮湿或户外路径需要把接口密封、单线密封塞、空腔处理、出线、接点封装和分支应力防护作为一套密封系统审核。

title.zh: 工业设备与分布式传感器

copy.en: Multi-drop branches connect proximity switches, valves, indicator lamps and local I/O along machines and conveyor systems.
copy.zh: 多路分支沿设备与输送系统连接接近开关、阀、指示灯和局部I/O。

copy.en: Connector tails link motors, pumps, heaters, thermostats, switches and control boards while allowing selected components to be serviced independently.
copy.zh: 连接器尾线用于电机、泵、加热器、温控、开关和控制板，使指定器件可以独立检修。

copy.en: Ring-lug, ferrule and terminal pigtails organize connections among breakers, busbars, relays, switches and terminal blocks.
copy.zh: 环形端子、冷压端头和端子尾线用于整理断路器、母排、继电器、开关与端子排之间的连接。

copy.en: Sealed sensor tails, lighting branches and repair connectors are developed for heat, vibration, fluids and restricted service access.
copy.zh: 密封传感器尾线、灯具分支和维修接口针对热、振动、液体与受限检修空间开发。

copy.en: Breakout tails expose individual circuits for measurement, simulation and fixture connection while preserving an approved interface at the equipment side.
copy.zh: 引出尾线把独立回路提供给测量、模拟与工装，同时在设备侧保留批准接口。

title.zh: 自动化单元与机器人末端工具

copy.en: Compact branches distribute power and signals among grippers, sensors, valves and tool changers where branch geometry and repeated movement must be coordinated.
copy.zh: 紧凑分支在线爪、传感器、阀和换工具系统之间分配电源与信号，需要协调分支几何与重复运动。

copy.en: Confirm connector systems, pin map, branch loads, splice method, environment, tail preparation, quantity and required records.
copy.zh: 确认接口系统、针脚表、分支负载、接点方式、环境、尾端处理、数量与所需记录。

copy.en: Verify wires, contacts, housings, seals, splice components, sleeves, labels and approved alternatives before the first article is released.
copy.zh: 首件放行前核实线材、触点、壳体、密封件、接点件、套管、标签与批准替代。

copy.en: Cut and strip to controlled lengths, terminate contacts, prepare conductor combinations and keep strands clean before the joint is made.
copy.zh: 按照受控长度下线与剥线，完成端子端接，准备导体组合，并在制作接点前保持线芯清洁。

copy.en: Set the splice position, branch angles, stagger, sleeves, seals, conduit, labels and connector orientation on the approved fixture or dimensional reference.
copy.zh: 依据批准工装或尺寸基准设定接点位置、分支角度、错位、套管、密封、波纹管、标签与接口方向。

copy.en: Verify continuity, circuit mapping, polarity, terminal seating, branch dimensions and visible protection. Pull or other mechanical checks follow the agreed project plan.
copy.zh: 核对导通、回路对应、极性、端子到位、分支尺寸与可见防护。拉力或其他机械项目依据批准计划执行。

copy.en: The approved sample, drawing, BOM, branch board, inspection points and packaging method become the repeat-production reference.
copy.zh: 确认样品、图纸、BOM、分支板、检验点与包装方式共同成为重复生产基准。

copy.en: A branch joint should not become the bend hinge or pull point. Stagger, sleeve length, support and route are arranged so installation and movement loads bypass the conductor transition.
copy.zh: 分支接点不应成为弯曲铰点或拉力点。通过错位、套管长度、支撑与路径，让安装和运动载荷避开导体过渡。

copy.en: Main conductors, splices and shared terminals are reviewed against the sum and duty cycle of branch loads, contact resistance, bundling and ambient temperature.
copy.zh: 主干导体、接点与共用端子需要结合分支负载总和、工作周期、接触电阻、成束和环境温度审核。

title.zh: 检修位置与接点可达性

copy.en: Repair joints and replaceable tails are positioned where technicians can inspect, support and reconnect them without disturbing unrelated circuits.
copy.zh: 维修接点与可替换尾线应布置在便于检查、支撑和重新连接的位置，减少对无关回路的扰动。

copy.en: Continuity and appearance are standard checks. Pull, insulation, dielectric, ingress or endurance tests require agreed samples, methods and limits. A sealed connector alone does not make every branch waterproof.
copy.zh: 导通与外观属于常规检查。拉力、绝缘、耐压、防护或寿命测试需要约定样品、方法和限值。仅有密封连接器不能代表整个分支都防水。

copy.en: Defined colours, labels, connector directions and branch datums help assembly and maintenance teams distinguish circuits without tracing loose wires repeatedly.
copy.zh: 明确线色、标签、接口方向和分支基准，帮助装配与维修人员区分回路，减少反复查线。

copy.en: A replacement pigtail can preserve the original equipment interface while documenting every new joint, material and circuit change.
copy.zh: 替换尾线可以保留原设备接口，同时记录每个新增接点、材料与回路变化。

copy.en: A branch board and approved dimensions reproduce tail lengths, split points and connector orientation across later batches.
copy.zh: 分支板与批准尺寸可以在后续批次中复现尾端长度、分叉点和接口方向。

title.en: A complete interface instead of loose components
title.zh: 交付完整接口而非散件

copy.en: The connector, contacts, wires, joints, protection and labels arrive as one inspected assembly ready for the agreed installation process.
copy.zh: 连接器、端子、线材、接点、防护与标签作为一个经过检查的组件交付，匹配约定安装流程。

q.en: What is the difference between a pigtail and a branch harness?
q.zh: 尾线和分支线束有什么区别？

a.en: A pigtail usually has a connector or terminal system at one end and free or prepared leads at the other. A branch harness divides one or more circuits into two or more controlled tails. Some products combine both structures.
a.zh: 尾线通常一端带连接器或端子系统，另一端为开口或已处理引线；分支线束把一个或多个回路分成两条以上受控尾端，有些产品会同时包含两种结构。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide connector and mating part numbers, pin table, branch drawing with datums, each tail length, conductor sizes, loads, splice and sealing requirements, environment, quantity and inspections.
a.zh: 建议提供连接器与对插件型号、针脚表、带基准的分支图、各尾端长度、导体规格、负载、接点与密封要求、环境、数量和检验项目。

q.en: Can you reproduce a pigtail from a sample?
q.zh: 可以依据样品复制尾线吗？

a.en: Yes, but hidden pin routes, conductor ratings, plating, internal splices and acceptance criteria still require confirmation. A sample is evidence, not a complete specification.
a.zh: 可以，但隐藏针脚、导体额定、镀层、内部接点与验收标准仍需确认。样品是开发依据，不是完整规格。

q.en: Which splice method should be used?
q.zh: 应该使用哪种接点方式？
