a.en: The method depends on conductor combination, current, space, environment, available tooling and customer acceptance. Crimp splices, ultrasonic welding, soldering or other methods are reviewed per project.
a.zh: 接点方式取决于导体组合、电流、空间、环境、可用工装和客户验收。压接接点、超声波焊接、焊锡或其他方式按项目审核。

q.en: Can a repair pigtail be waterproof?
q.zh: 维修尾线可以做防水吗？

a.en: It can be designed for a defined ingress test, but the connector, wire seals, unused cavities, repair joints, cable entry and installed orientation must all be included in the sealing review.
a.zh: 可以针对明确的防护测试设计，但连接器、单线密封、空腔、维修接点、出线与安装方向都必须纳入密封审核。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished assemblies receive continuity and appearance inspection. Pin mapping, polarity, terminal retention, dimensions, labels, splice protection and other electrical or mechanical checks are added according to the approved plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查。针脚对应、极性、端子保持、尺寸、标签、接点防护以及其他电气或机械项目按批准计划增加。

intro.en: A turnkey harness project covers a more complete supply scope: material sourcing, connector and accessory preparation, assembly, labeling, inspection and packed delivery to an agreed drawing and BOM.
intro.zh: 交钥匙线束项目覆盖更完整的供货范围，包括物料采购、连接器与附件准备、线束装配、标签、检验以及依据约定图纸和BOM包装交付。

knowledge.en: The key difference is configuration control. Drawings, BOM revisions, approved sources, substitutions, tooling, test methods, labels and packing instructions must stay aligned so a repeat order reproduces the approved assembly.
knowledge.zh: 交钥匙项目的关键是配置管理。图纸、BOM版本、认可来源、替代规则、工装、测试方法、标签和包装说明必须保持一致，才能让重复订单复现确认样品。

notes.en: Define the exact supply boundary, customer-supplied parts, approved manufacturers, substitution approval process, inspection records, packing unit and revision authority. Missing ownership rules create schedule and compatibility risk.
notes.zh: 需要明确供货边界、客供物料、认可制造商、替代审批流程、检验记录、包装单位和版本批准权限。责任边界不清会增加进度与兼容风险。

delivery.en: The project normally passes through DFM review, BOM and source confirmation, first-article build, customer approval and controlled production release. Future changes are handled through a recorded revision process.
delivery.zh: 项目通常经过可制造性审核、BOM与来源确认、首件制作、客户批准和受控量产放行；后续变更通过可追踪的版本流程处理。

subtitle.en: One controlled supply scope from drawing to packed assembly
subtitle.zh: 从图纸到包装组件的一体化受控供货

lead.en: A turnkey harness is defined by responsibility, not by appearance. The supply scope may include engineering review, source-controlled wires and connectors, customer-supplied parts, terminals, seals, fuses, relays, clips, labels, protective coverings, fixtures, electrical tests, records and unit packaging. The purpose is to deliver an approved assembly that can be installed or issued to production without the customer coordinating many separate component and process suppliers.
lead.zh: 交钥匙线束的核心是责任范围，而不是外观。供货可以覆盖工程审核、受控来源的线材与连接器、客供件、端子、密封件、保险、继电器、卡扣、标签、防护材料、工装、电气测试、记录和单件包装。目标是交付经过批准、可以直接进入安装或生产领用的完整组件，减少客户协调多个零件与工序供应商的工作。

benefits.zh: 交钥匙供货带来的改善

copy.en: Complete looms are produced to approved drawings, BOMs, work instructions and inspection plans, with every connector, branch, label and protective feature included in the released configuration.
copy.zh: 依据批准图纸、BOM、作业指导与检验计划生产完整线束，接口、分支、标签和防护结构全部纳入放行配置。

copy.en: Multiple related harnesses, jumpers, grounding leads and accessories are grouped by machine, cabinet, station or assembly step to simplify line-side issue and installation.
copy.zh: 把相关主线束、跳线、接地线与附件按照设备、机柜、工位或装配步骤组成套件，便于线边领用与安装。

title.en: Harnesses with connectors, seals and protection
title.zh: 含接口、密封与防护的完整线束

copy.en: The delivered assembly includes mating-specific contacts, seals, locks, cavity plugs, conduit, braid, grommets and strain relief rather than leaving critical finishing work to the customer.
copy.zh: 交付组件包含匹配对插的端子、密封、锁止、堵孔件、波纹管、编织、护线圈与应力防护，避免把关键收尾工序留给客户。

title.zh: 保险、继电器与配电子组件

copy.en: Fuse holders, relays, sockets, bus links and labeled branches can be assembled and electrically checked as one controlled module when the project defines the ratings and acceptance plan.
copy.zh: 在项目明确额定与验收计划时，可把保险座、继电器、底座、母排连接与标识分支组装并作为一个受控模块检查。

title.zh: 客供件与混合来源组件

copy.en: Customer-supplied devices can be combined with sourced wires, connectors and accessories under documented receiving, ownership, shortage and replacement rules.
copy.zh: 客供器件可以与采购线材、连接器和附件组合，但需要记录收料、所有权、短缺与替换规则。

title.zh: 可直接安装的标识包装套件

copy.en: Harnesses are labeled, protected, coiled or formed, counted and packed to the agreed unit so production receives the correct assembly in the required sequence.
copy.zh: 线束按照约定单位完成标签、防护、盘绕或成型、计数与包装，使生产按所需顺序收到正确组件。

title.en: Wire, cable and conductor source control
title.zh: 线材、电缆与导体来源控制

copy.en: Manufacturer, construction, gauge, insulation, colour, temperature range and required documents are fixed in the BOM or approved source list. Equivalent wording alone does not authorize a substitution.
copy.zh: 制造商、结构、规格、绝缘、颜色、温度范围与所需文件应固定在BOM或批准来源清单中，仅写“同等品”不能自动授权替代。

copy.en: Housings, contacts, seals, locks, plating and wire ranges are controlled as complete interface systems. Mating part data is retained so purchasing changes do not silently break compatibility.
copy.zh: 壳体、端子、密封、锁止、镀层与适配线径作为完整接口系统管理，并保留对插件资料，避免采购变化悄然破坏兼容。

copy.en: Conduit, braid, tape, heat-shrink, boots, clips, ties, grommets, brackets and hardware are selected from the real route, environment and assembly method, then included in the controlled supply scope.
copy.zh: 波纹管、编织、胶带、热缩、护套、卡扣、扎带、护线圈、支架与紧固件依据真实路径、环境与装配方式选择，并纳入受控供货范围。

copy.en: Part labels, circuit identification, inspection records, protective caps, bags, trays and cartons are specified according to traceability, transport and line-side handling needs.
copy.zh: 零件标签、回路标识、检验记录、防尘帽、袋、托盘与纸箱按照追踪、运输和线边处理需求定义。

title.en: Turn incomplete data into a controlled package
title.zh: 把不完整资料转化为受控包

copy.en: Drawings, pin tables, samples, equipment photos and component data are reviewed for gaps. Assumptions and open points are recorded before the drawing, BOM and inspection plan are released.
copy.zh: 审核图纸、针脚表、样品、设备照片与器件资料中的缺口，在放行图纸、BOM与检验计划前记录假设和待确认项。

title.en: Convert a legacy sample into repeat production
title.zh: 把旧样品转化为重复生产

copy.en: An existing assembly is measured and electrically mapped, while hidden ratings, unavailable parts and undocumented processes are identified for customer review before a repeatable specification is frozen.
copy.zh: 对现有组件进行测量和电气映射，同时识别隐藏额定、停产物料与未记录工艺，在冻结可重复规格前交由客户审核。

title.zh: 管理难采购物料与替代

copy.en: Long-lead or unavailable items are flagged early. Alternatives are compared by mating, rating, material, tooling, approval documents, installation impact and customer authorization before release.
copy.zh: 提前识别长交期或停供物料。替代件从对插、额定、材料、工装、认可文件、安装影响与客户授权等方面比较后放行。

title.en: Deliver by kit, station or production sequence
title.zh: 按套件、工位或生产顺序交付

copy.en: Packing units, quantities, labels and protective methods are aligned with the customer production sequence so correct harnesses and accessories reach the correct station together.
copy.zh: 包装单位、数量、标签与防护方式配合客户生产顺序，使正确线束与附件一起到达正确工位。

copy.en: Complete machine looms and installation kits covering panels, sensors, motors, actuators and distributed modules.
copy.zh: 覆盖面板、传感器、电机、执行器与分布式模块的完整设备线束与安装套件。

copy.en: Station-specific harness sets for robots, tooling, conveyors, safety devices and control cabinets, labeled to the cell build sequence.
copy.zh: 为机器人、末端工具、输送、安全器件与控制柜提供按单元装配顺序标识的工位线束套件。

copy.en: Pre-terminated panel wiring, grounding leads, jumpers and fuse or relay subassemblies supplied to drawings and terminal schedules.
copy.zh: 依据图纸与端子表交付预制面板线、接地线、跳线以及保险或继电器子组件。

copy.en: Internal harness kits joining control boards, motors, heaters, switches and user interfaces with appliance-specific routing and labels.
copy.zh: 按照设备特定路径与标签连接控制板、电机、加热器、开关和人机界面的内部线束套件。

copy.en: Source-controlled harnesses and field connection kits for pumps, treatment modules, monitoring devices and auxiliary systems.
copy.zh: 为泵、处理模块、监测器件与辅助系统提供来源受控线束和现场连接套件。

copy.en: Low-volume cable and harness sets with fixtures, identifiers and documented inspections for benches, instruments and specialized equipment.
copy.zh: 为测试台、仪器和专用设备提供含工装、标识与记录检验的小批量线缆线束套件。

copy.en: Define what is included, customer-supplied parts, approved manufacturers, expected records, quantity, packaging unit and revision authority.
copy.zh: 明确包含范围、客供件、认可制造商、所需记录、数量、包装单位与版本权限。

copy.en: Verify each material, source, lead time, minimum quantity, substitution rule and incoming requirement before committing the production schedule.
copy.zh: 承诺生产计划前核实每项物料、来源、交期、最小数量、替代规则与来料要求。

copy.en: Build the representative assembly, confirm routing, connector direction, branch geometry, accessories, labels and installation against the agreed equipment or fixture.
copy.zh: 制作代表性组件，并在约定设备或工装上确认路径、接口方向、分支几何、附件、标签与安装。

copy.en: Use released work documents, fixtures, calibrated or maintained tools and defined in-process points for cutting, termination, assembly and protection.
copy.zh: 使用放行作业文件、工装、受校准或维护工具和明确过程检验点执行下线、端接、组装与防护。

copy.en: Check circuit mapping, continuity, polarity, terminal retention, dimensions, labels and appearance, with additional tests performed only to the approved project plan.
copy.zh: 检查回路对应、导通、极性、端子保持、尺寸、标签与外观，其他测试仅依据批准项目计划执行。

title.en: Kit verification, records and shipment release
title.zh: 套件核对、记录与出货放行

copy.en: Confirm item count, accessory completeness, inspection status, protective packing, labels and required records before each production unit is released.
copy.zh: 每个生产单位放行前核对物料数量、附件完整、检验状态、防护包装、标签与所需记录。

copy.en: The released drawing, BOM, work instruction and test program must describe the same revision. A change in one document cannot be allowed to create an undocumented mixed configuration.
copy.zh: 放行图纸、BOM、作业指导与测试程序必须描述同一版本，不能让单一文件变更形成未记录的混合配置。

copy.en: Material deviations record the reason, affected quantity, technical comparison, approval and expiry. Temporary acceptance does not automatically change the standard BOM.
copy.zh: 物料偏差记录原因、影响数量、技术比较、批准与有效期，临时接收不会自动修改标准BOM。

copy.en: Branch boards, applicators, insertion aids and inspection fixtures are maintained so later batches reproduce dimensions, terminations and assembly sequence rather than only matching appearance.
copy.zh: 维护分支板、压接模具、插壳辅助与检验工装，使后续批次复现尺寸、端接和装配顺序，而不仅是外观相似。

copy.en: Records cover the agreed harness checks. Complete equipment certification, environmental qualification or regulatory claims require separately defined responsibility, samples and responsible laboratories.
copy.zh: 记录覆盖约定线束检查。完整设备认证、环境鉴定或法规结论需要另行明确责任、样品与责任实验室。

title.zh: 减少供应商与交接环节

copy.en: Engineering, sourcing, assembly, inspection and packaging are coordinated within one approved supply scope instead of being split among disconnected vendors.
copy.zh: 工程、采购、组装、检验与包装在一个批准供货范围内协调，减少分散供应商之间的交接。

copy.en: Approved sources, customer-supplied parts, revisions, substitutions and records have named ownership, reducing schedule and compatibility disputes.
copy.zh: 认可来源、客供件、版本、替代与记录都有明确责任，减少进度与兼容争议。

title.en: Assemblies ready for installation and service

copy.en: Correct labels, accessories, protection and packing arrive together, reducing line-side preparation and missing-component interruptions.
copy.zh: 正确标签、附件、防护与包装一起到位，减少线边准备和缺件中断。

title.en: Repeat orders reproduce the approved result
title.zh: 重复订单复现确认结果

copy.en: A frozen package of drawing, BOM, process, fixture, test and packing data carries the approved first article into later production and controlled revisions.
copy.zh: 冻结的图纸、BOM、工艺、工装、测试与包装数据，把确认首件延续到后续生产和受控变更。

q.en: What does turnkey supply include?
q.zh: 交钥匙供货包含什么？

a.en: The exact scope is project-specific. It can include engineering review, sourcing, customer-supplied parts, harness assembly, accessories, labels, inspection, records, kitting and packaging. The quotation and approved documents define the boundary.
a.zh: 准确范围按项目确定，可以包含工程审核、采购、客供件、线束组装、附件、标签、检验、记录、配套与包装。报价与批准文件定义边界。

q.en: Can you work with customer-supplied parts?
q.zh: 可以使用客户提供的物料吗？

a.en: Yes, when receiving condition, quantities, ownership, shortage handling, unused return, traceability and responsibility for part suitability are agreed before production.
a.zh: 可以，但生产前需约定收料状态、数量、所有权、短缺处理、余料退回、追踪与物料适用责任。

q.en: How are substitutions handled?
q.zh: 替代件怎样管理？

a.en: Alternatives are compared technically and commercially, then released only through the agreed customer approval route. A temporary deviation is recorded separately from the standard BOM.
a.zh: 替代件经过技术与商务比较，只能通过约定客户审批路径放行；临时偏差与标准BOM分开记录。

q.en: Can an existing sample become a turnkey product?
q.zh: 现有样品可以转成交钥匙产品吗？

a.en: Yes, after dimensions, circuits, materials, hidden joints, acceptance criteria, unavailable components and packing requirements are converted into controlled documents and approved.
a.zh: 可以，需要把尺寸、回路、材料、隐藏接点、验收标准、停供器件与包装要求转化为受控文件并批准。

q.en: Which records can accompany shipment?
q.zh: 出货可以附带哪些记录？

a.en: Available records depend on the project and may include inspection status, electrical test output, material or lot traceability and packing lists. Required formats must be agreed before quotation or release.
a.zh: 可提供记录取决于项目，可能包括检验状态、电气测试输出、物料或批次追踪与装箱单。所需格式应在报价或放行前约定。

q.en: Does turnkey supply mean the complete equipment is certified?
q.zh: 交钥匙供货是否代表整机已经认证？

a.en: No. Turnkey describes the agreed supply responsibility. Complete equipment certification and regulatory compliance remain separate activities unless methods, samples, laboratories and responsibility are explicitly included.
a.zh: 不是。交钥匙描述约定供货责任。整机认证与法规合规属于独立工作，除非明确纳入方法、样品、实验室与责任范围。

intro.en: Braided protection harnesses use textile, expandable, metal or other specified braiding to protect or organize a cable bundle. Protective braid and conductive shielding braid serve different functions and are not interchangeable.
intro.zh: 编织防护线束使用纺织、扩张、金属或其他指定编织层保护和整理线束。机械防护编织层与导电屏蔽编织层用途不同，不能混为一谈。

knowledge.en: Material, coverage, expansion range, abrasion behavior, temperature, cut-edge treatment and branch transitions determine whether the braid can be assembled and maintained. Shielding braid additionally requires a defined termination and grounding approach.
knowledge.zh: 材料、覆盖率、扩张范围、耐磨表现、温度、切口处理和分支过渡决定编织层是否便于装配与维护；屏蔽编织层还必须明确端接和接地方式。

notes.en: State whether the goal is abrasion protection, appearance, bundle management or electrical shielding. Provide maximum bundle diameter, branch positions, temperature and chemical exposure, termination method and required coverage or test reference.
notes.zh: 应说明目标是耐磨、外观、束线管理还是电气屏蔽，并提供最大束径、分支位置、温度与化学环境、端接方式以及要求的覆盖率或测试依据。

delivery.en: Material and braid size are confirmed on a representative sample. Cut edges, branch transitions, end fixation, flexibility and appearance are reviewed before the protection process is released for production.
delivery.zh: 通过代表性样品确认编织材料与规格，再核对切口、分支过渡、端部固定、柔性和外观，确认后放行防护工序。

subtitle.en: Abrasion protection, bundle control and defined electrical shielding
subtitle.zh: 耐磨防护、束线管理与明确的电气屏蔽

lead.en: A braided protection harness can use PET, nylon, aramid, glass fibre, tinned copper, stainless steel or another specified braid, but these materials do not perform the same job. Expandable textile braid mainly organizes and protects the bundle. Conductive braid can form part of an EMI shielding system only when coverage, termination and grounding are designed. The finished harness therefore depends on bundle diameter, expansion range, abrasion, temperature, chemicals, movement, branch geometry and end treatment.
lead.zh: 编织防护线束可以使用PET、尼龙、芳纶、玻璃纤维、镀锡铜、不锈钢或其他指定编织材料，但这些材料承担的功能并不相同。扩张型纺织编织主要用于束线与机械防护；导电编织只有在覆盖率、端接和接地经过设计时，才能成为EMI屏蔽系统的一部分。因此成品需要结合束径、扩张范围、磨损、温度、化学环境、运动、分支几何与端部处理开发。

copy.en: Lightweight expandable braid organizes irregular bundles and provides general abrasion resistance. The nominal size must cover both the minimum and maximum bundle diameter without excessive looseness or tension.
copy.zh: 轻量扩张编织用于整理不规则线束并提供一般耐磨防护，标称规格需要同时覆盖最小与最大束径，避免过松或过度拉伸。

copy.en: Soft textile or nylon systems are used where repeated contact, flexibility, noise reduction or a particular surface feel matters. Fibre, weave and edge treatment are selected from the actual duty cycle.
copy.zh: 柔性纺织或尼龙系统适用于反复接触、柔性、降噪或特定表面触感需求，纤维、织法与切口处理依据真实工作周期选择。

title.en: High-temperature glass fibre or aramid braid
title.zh: 耐高温玻纤或芳纶编织

copy.en: Heat-resistant braid protects bundles near heaters, engines or hot equipment surfaces. Temperature exposure, flexing, coating and fibre shedding must be reviewed rather than relying on a generic high-temperature label.
copy.zh: 耐热编织用于靠近加热器、发动机或高温设备表面的线束，需要审核温度暴露、弯曲、涂层与纤维脱落，而不能只依赖笼统的耐高温标签。

copy.en: Conductive braid can provide shielding when material, optical coverage, transfer path, shield termination and chassis or circuit grounding are defined as one system.
copy.zh: 导电编织只有在材料、光学覆盖率、传递路径、屏蔽端接与机壳或回路接地作为一个系统定义时，才能提供有效屏蔽。

title.zh: 不锈钢与重型耐磨编织

copy.en: Metal or reinforced braid is considered for severe abrasion, mechanical protection or specialized environments. Weight, bend stiffness, cut edges, corrosion pairing and termination influence suitability.
copy.zh: 金属或增强编织适用于严重磨损、机械防护或特殊环境，其重量、弯曲刚度、切口、腐蚀配对与端接方式都会影响适用性。

title.en: Hybrid braid, conduit and sealed transitions
title.zh: 编织、波纹管与密封混合防护

copy.en: One harness may combine braid for flexible runs, conduit for exposed zones and sealed boots or backshells at interfaces. Transition points are designed so protection does not end at the most vulnerable location.
copy.zh: 同一线束可以在柔性路径使用编织、暴露区域使用波纹管，并在接口处使用密封护套或尾壳。过渡点要避免防护恰好终止在最脆弱位置。

title.en: Braid fibre, wire and weave construction
title.zh: 编织纤维、金属丝与织法

copy.en: Material chemistry, filament or wire diameter, weave density, expansion ratio, colour and coating affect abrasion, flexibility, temperature and compatibility with oils or cleaning agents.
copy.zh: 材料化学、纤维或金属丝直径、织密度、扩张率、颜色与涂层会影响耐磨、柔性、温度和油品或清洁剂兼容。

title.en: Underlying wire, cable and connector system
title.zh: 内部线材、电缆与接口系统

copy.en: Braiding does not correct an unsuitable conductor, insulation, cable jacket or connector. The protected bundle is first defined electrically and mechanically, then the outer braid is selected around it.
copy.zh: 编织不能弥补不合适的导体、绝缘、电缆护套或连接器。应先定义内部线束的电气与机械结构，再围绕它选择外部编织。

copy.en: Crimp ferrules, shield rings, backshells, drain wires, grounding leads and conductive tapes are selected for the required termination geometry and current or frequency path.
copy.zh: 压接套环、屏蔽环、尾壳、排流线、接地线与导电胶带依据所需端接几何和电流或频率路径选择。

title.en: End fixation, labels and cut-edge treatment
title.zh: 端部固定、标签与切口处理

copy.en: Heat-shrink, boots, clamps, thread, tape or molded strain relief can secure braid ends. Hot cutting, sealed edges or covered transitions prevent fraying according to the material and service needs.
copy.zh: 热缩、护套、卡箍、绑线、胶带或注塑应力防护可固定编织端部；热切、封边或覆盖过渡依据材料与检修需求防止散边。

title.en: Select braid from the real protection goal
title.zh: 从真实防护目标选择编织

copy.en: The project first separates abrasion, bundle management, appearance, heat exposure and electrical shielding. Material and construction are then chosen for the required functions instead of treating every braid as equivalent.
copy.zh: 项目首先区分耐磨、束线管理、外观、热暴露与电气屏蔽，再针对所需功能选择材料和结构，避免把所有编织视为同一种产品。

copy.en: For EMI projects, braid coverage, overlap, branch continuity, connector backshell, drain path and grounding location are recorded. Shielding performance requires a defined test method and complete installed configuration.
copy.zh: EMI项目记录编织覆盖、搭接、分支连续、接口尾壳、排流路径与接地点。屏蔽性能需要明确测试方法和完整装机配置。

copy.en: Braid size, branch breakout, overlap, end fixation and bend path are coordinated so the covering follows movement without bunching, opening or loading the connector exit.
copy.zh: 协调编织规格、分支引出、搭接、端部固定与弯曲路径，使防护层随运动变化而不堆积、张开或拉扯接口出线。

title.en: Add protection to an existing harness

copy.en: A representative sample is measured at connectors, branches and maximum bundle points. Installation access, removable components and required disassembly determine whether braid can be added without redesigning the loom.
copy.zh: 在接口、分支与最大束径处测量代表样品，并结合安装空间、可拆器件与拆解需求判断是否能在不重构线束的情况下增加编织。

title.zh: 机器人与重复运动设备

copy.en: Flexible protective braid organizes cables around moving arms and tooling while branch, bend and attachment points remain matched to the motion path.
copy.zh: 柔性防护编织整理运动臂与工具周围电缆，分支、弯曲和固定点仍需匹配运动路径。

copy.en: Abrasion, chips, oil and service contact drive braid, conduit and transition choices around cabinets, spindles, sensors and auxiliary systems.
copy.zh: 机柜、主轴、传感器与辅助系统周围的磨损、切屑、油污和检修接触决定编织、波纹管与过渡结构。

copy.en: Glass fibre, aramid or specified high-temperature braid protects cable surfaces near heaters, ovens and thermal equipment when the full temperature profile is known.
copy.zh: 在掌握完整温度曲线后，玻纤、芳纶或指定耐高温编织可用于加热器、炉体与热设备附近的线缆表面防护。

copy.en: Conductive braid and controlled terminations can support shielding for measurement, sensor and communication circuits where the grounding scheme is defined.
copy.zh: 在接地方案明确时，导电编织与受控端接可支持测量、传感与通信回路的屏蔽。

copy.en: Moisture, salt, chemicals and sunlight require braid material and underlying cable jackets that are compatible with the complete exposure, not just an attractive outer weave.
copy.zh: 湿气、盐分、化学品与日照要求编织材料和内部电缆护套共同适配完整环境，而不仅是外层织物看起来耐用。

copy.en: Neat abrasion-resistant braid supports organized, serviceable visible cable runs in kiosks, appliances, packaging equipment and production fixtures.
copy.zh: 整洁耐磨编织适用于售卖设备、电器、包装设备与生产工装中可见且需要检修的布线路径。

copy.en: Confirm abrasion, heat, chemicals, movement, shielding, appearance, bundle range, branches, quantities and required validation before material selection.
copy.zh: 选料前确认磨损、热、化学、运动、屏蔽、外观、束径范围、分支、数量与所需验证。

copy.en: Measure minimum, nominal and maximum bundle diameters at straight sections, branches, splices and connector exits, including any tape or underlying conduit.
copy.zh: 测量直线段、分支、接点与接口出线处的最小、标称和最大束径，并包含胶带或底层波纹管。

copy.en: Cut or braid to controlled lengths, manage fray, apply over the formed harness and maintain the specified overlap, tension and branch transitions.
copy.zh: 按照受控长度切割或编织，处理散边，套装到成型线束并保持规定搭接、张力与分支过渡。

copy.en: Secure ends with approved heat-shrink, clamps, backshells, ferrules, thread, tape or molding without creating sharp edges or blocking connector locks.
copy.zh: 使用批准热缩、卡箍、尾壳、套环、绑线、胶带或注塑固定端部，同时避免锐边和遮挡接口锁止。

copy.en: Check braid coverage, branch openings, end fixation, flexibility, connector operation and appearance. Conductive shielding tests are added only to the approved method.
copy.zh: 检查编织覆盖、分支开口、端部固定、柔性、接口操作与外观。导电屏蔽测试仅按批准方法增加。

copy.en: The approved sample records braid material, size, coverage, cut method, transition geometry, termination and inspection points for later production.
copy.zh: 确认样品记录编织材料、规格、覆盖、切割方式、过渡几何、端接与检验点，作为后续生产基准。

copy.en: A braid that is too tight can restrict movement, while an oversized braid can bunch or rub. Expansion, bend radius, attachment spacing and motion cycle are reviewed together.
copy.zh: 编织过紧会限制运动，过大则可能堆积或摩擦，需要共同审核扩张、弯曲半径、固定间距与运动周期。

copy.en: Fibre and coating resistance are checked against edges, chips, oil, coolant, cleaners, dust and the actual contact surface. A cosmetic braid may not survive industrial exposure.
copy.zh: 审核纤维与涂层对锐边、切屑、油、冷却液、清洁剂、粉尘和真实接触面的耐受，装饰性编织未必适合工业暴露。

copy.en: Conductive braid performance depends on coverage, low-impedance termination, branch continuity, connector backshell and grounding topology. Visual metal coverage alone is not an EMI result.
copy.zh: 导电编织性能取决于覆盖、低阻抗端接、分支连续、接口尾壳与接地拓扑，仅肉眼看到金属覆盖不能代表EMI结果。

copy.en: Abrasion, temperature, flammability, shielding, ingress or endurance claims require defined specimens, methods and acceptance limits. Category names do not replace project validation.
copy.zh: 耐磨、温度、阻燃、屏蔽、防护或寿命结论需要明确试样、方法与限值，小类名称不能替代项目验证。

title.zh: 束线更整洁且便于检修

copy.en: Defined braid size, branch openings and removable end treatments organize cables without permanently hiding the interfaces technicians need to reach.
copy.zh: 明确编织规格、分支开口与可拆端部处理，在整理线缆的同时不永久遮挡技术人员需要接近的接口。

title.en: Protection matched to the actual duty

copy.en: Materials are selected for abrasion, heat, chemicals, motion or shielding as separate functions, reducing unnecessary weight and unsupported claims.
copy.zh: 针对耐磨、热、化学、运动或屏蔽分别选择材料，减少不必要重量和无依据性能描述。

title.zh: 分支与端接质量可重复

copy.en: Controlled overlap, transitions, end fixation and inspection points reproduce the approved covering across later batches.
copy.zh: 受控搭接、过渡、端部固定与检验点可以在后续批次中复现批准防护结构。

title.zh: 交付完整防护线束组件

copy.en: The underlying electrical harness, outer protection, connector transitions, labels and grounding features are reviewed and delivered as one assembly.
copy.zh: 内部电气线束、外部防护、接口过渡、标签与接地结构作为一个组件审核和交付。

q.en: Does every braided harness provide EMI shielding?
q.zh: 所有编织线束都能提供EMI屏蔽吗？

a.en: No. PET, nylon and other textile braids mainly provide organization and mechanical protection. EMI shielding requires conductive material, defined coverage, termination, grounding and an agreed validation method.
a.zh: 不能。PET、尼龙等纺织编织主要提供束线与机械防护。EMI屏蔽需要导电材料、明确覆盖、端接、接地和约定验证方法。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: State the protection goal, braid material if mandatory, minimum and maximum bundle diameters, branches, temperature, chemicals, movement, termination, colour, quantity and required tests.
a.zh: 请说明防护目标、指定编织材料、最小与最大束径、分支、温度、化学、运动、端接、颜色、数量与所需测试。

q.en: Can braid be added to an existing harness?
q.zh: 可以给现有线束增加编织吗？

a.en: Often yes, when connector dimensions, removable parts, branch geometry and installation access allow the selected braid to pass and terminate correctly. A representative sample should be reviewed.
a.zh: 通常可以，但接口尺寸、可拆部件、分支几何与安装空间必须允许所选编织正确通过并端接，建议审核代表性样品。

q.en: How is braid size selected?
q.zh: 编织规格怎样选择？

a.en: Selection uses the complete diameter range, expansion ratio, required coverage, bend and branch geometry. Nominal diameter alone is not enough because excessive expansion changes coverage and stiffness.
a.zh: 需要结合完整束径范围、扩张率、所需覆盖、弯曲和分支几何选择。仅看标称直径不够，因为过度扩张会改变覆盖与刚度。

q.en: How are braid ends prevented from fraying?
q.zh: 编织端部怎样防止散边？

a.en: Depending on material and service needs, ends may be hot-cut, sealed, folded, covered with heat-shrink, tied, clamped, terminated in a backshell or incorporated into molding.
a.zh: 依据材料与检修需求，端部可以热切、封边、折返、覆盖热缩、绑扎、卡箍、端接到尾壳或纳入注塑。

q.en: Which inspections are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished assemblies receive continuity and appearance inspection plus checks of coverage, branch transitions, end fixation, flexibility and connector operation. Shielding or environmental tests follow the approved plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查，并核对覆盖、分支过渡、端部固定、柔性与接口操作。屏蔽或环境测试依据批准计划执行。

intro.en: Prototype and small-batch harnesses support engineering validation, replacement trials, pilot equipment and low-volume projects where the design may still change. The objective is to learn quickly without losing configuration control.
intro.zh: 样品与小批量线束适用于工程验证、替代试验、试制设备和低用量项目，设计在这一阶段可能仍会调整，重点是在快速验证的同时保持版本受控。

knowledge.en: Prototype materials and manual processes may differ from the final production route. Temporary substitutions, hand-built features and unvalidated assumptions should be identified so a functional sample is not mistaken for a frozen mass-production specification.
knowledge.zh: 样品物料和手工作业方式可能与最终量产工艺不同。临时替代、手工结构或尚未验证的假设应明确记录，避免把通过功能试验的样品误认为已经冻结的量产规格。

notes.en: Provide the current drawing revision, test purpose, must-use parts, acceptable temporary substitutions, quantity, target date and expected next revision. Clarify which dimensions or functions are still under evaluation.
notes.zh: 建议提供当前图纸版本、测试目的、必须使用的物料、可接受的临时替代、数量、目标日期和下一版计划，并说明哪些尺寸或功能仍在验证。

delivery.en: A review record identifies assumptions and open points before the sample is built. Feedback is converted into a revised drawing or BOM, and repeat production starts only from the customer-approved revision.
delivery.zh: 打样前通过审核记录列出假设与待确认项；样品反馈转化为新版图纸或BOM，重复生产只依据客户批准的版本启动。

subtitle.en: Fast engineering learning with controlled revisions
subtitle.zh: 快速完成工程验证，同时保持版本受控

lead.en: Prototype and small-batch harnesses cover proof-of-concept samples, fit checks, functional verification, pilot equipment, replacement trials and recurring low-volume builds. A sample may prove one purpose while other dimensions, materials or processes remain provisional. We therefore record the test objective, current revision, assumptions, temporary substitutions and open points, then convert the findings into a controlled drawing, BOM and inspection plan before repeat production.
lead.zh: 样品与小批量线束覆盖概念验证、装配检查、功能验证、试制设备、替代试验和持续低用量生产。一个样品可能只证明某项用途，其他尺寸、材料或工艺仍处于临时状态。因此我们会记录测试目标、当前版本、假设、临时替代与待确认项，再把反馈转化为受控图纸、BOM和检验计划，之后才进入重复生产。

copy.en: Used to verify a circuit idea, interface choice or basic function before the mechanical package is frozen. Provisional dimensions and substitutions are marked clearly.
copy.zh: 在机械结构冻结前验证回路思路、接口选择或基础功能，临时尺寸与替代物料会被明确标注。

copy.en: Focuses on connector mating, branch position, routing, clips, bend space and service access. Electrical load testing may remain outside this sample's approved purpose.
copy.zh: 重点核对接口插合、分支位置、路径、卡扣、弯曲空间与检修可达性，电气负载测试可能不属于该样品的批准用途。

copy.en: Built with defined pin mapping and agreed materials to validate continuity, polarity, signal or equipment operation under a stated test setup.
copy.zh: 依据明确针脚与约定物料制作，在规定测试配置下验证导通、极性、信号或设备运行。

copy.en: A small controlled batch checks assembly sequence, work instructions, tooling, inspection points and variation before a wider production release.
copy.zh: 通过受控小批量检查装配顺序、作业指导、工装、检验点与波动，再决定是否扩大生产。

copy.en: A physical reference can support measurement and circuit mapping, but mating interfaces, hidden components, ratings and intended function still require customer confirmation.
copy.zh: 可依据实物参考进行测量与回路整理，但对插接口、隐藏元件、额定参数和预期功能仍需客户确认。

copy.en: For service parts, specialist equipment and low annual demand, the approved configuration is reproduced in manageable batches with revision and material control.
copy.zh: 适用于维修备件、专业设备与低年度用量，依据批准配置按合适批量重复生产，并保持版本与物料受控。

title.zh: 关键回路使用量产意向导体

copy.en: Current, voltage drop, temperature, flexing and termination determine which conductors must match the intended production design from the first functional sample.
copy.zh: 依据电流、压降、温度、弯曲与端接判断哪些导体必须从首个功能样品起就匹配量产意向。

copy.en: When a specified jacket, colour or accessory is unavailable, the substitute, reason, affected test and replacement plan are recorded rather than silently accepted as final.
copy.zh: 指定护套、颜色或附件暂缺时，记录替代项、原因、受影响测试与恢复计划，不能默认为最终配置。

title.zh: 使用有代表性的端子与接点

copy.en: Crimp geometry, conductor range, seals and splice construction influence both fit and electrical behavior, so critical interfaces should be production representative.
copy.zh: 压接几何、适用线径、密封与接点结构同时影响装配和电气表现，关键接口应具有量产代表性。

title.zh: 区分样品外观与性能验证

copy.en: A neat sealed connector does not by itself prove ingress, temperature or endurance. Materials and tests are tied to the stated sample purpose and final installation.
copy.zh: 外观整洁的密封接口并不能单独证明防护、温度或寿命，材料与测试必须对应样品目的和最终装机状态。

title.zh: 从不完整工程资料启动

copy.en: We can organize drawings, pin tables, photos, marked samples and equipment layouts into a review list that separates confirmed requirements from assumptions.
copy.zh: 可把图纸、针脚表、照片、标记样品与设备布局整理为审核清单，区分已确认要求与工程假设。

title.en: Build for one defined test purpose
title.zh: 围绕单一明确测试目的制作

copy.en: Fit, function, environmental and production-process samples answer different questions. Defining the purpose avoids unnecessary cost and misleading acceptance.
copy.zh: 装配、功能、环境与生产工艺样品回答的问题不同，先定义目的可避免无效成本和错误验收。

title.zh: 把反馈转化为受控版本

copy.en: Every approved change updates the applicable drawing, BOM, pin map, label or inspection requirement so the next build does not depend on memory.
copy.zh: 每项批准变更同步更新适用图纸、BOM、针脚、标签或检验要求，使下一次制作不依赖口头记忆。

title.zh: 从样品过渡到重复生产

copy.en: After design review, production-intent materials, tooling, work instructions and inspection points replace provisional methods before the configuration is released.
copy.zh: 设计审核后，以量产意向物料、工装、作业指导与检验点替代临时方法，再放行重复生产。

copy.en: Validates cabinet, sensor, actuator, motor and safety connections while the equipment layout is still being adjusted.
copy.zh: 在设备布局仍调整时验证机柜、传感器、执行器、电机与安全连接。

copy.en: Supports initial stations, packaging equipment and process modules before quantities and final routing are stable.
copy.zh: 支持初始工位、包装设备与工艺模块，在数量和最终布线路径稳定前完成验证。

copy.en: Connects instruments, fixtures, sensors and data-acquisition hardware for a defined experiment or verification setup.
copy.zh: 为明确的实验或验证配置连接仪器、工装、传感器与数据采集硬件。

copy.en: Checks internal routing, motors, heaters, controls and service connections before enclosure and assembly details are finalized.
copy.zh: 在外壳与装配细节定型前检查内部布线、电机、加热、控制与维修连接。

copy.en: Supports new end effectors, motion modules, sensors and controller interfaces through successive engineering revisions.
copy.zh: 支持新末端工具、运动模块、传感器与控制器接口的连续工程迭代。

copy.en: Suitable for treatment, monitoring, field-service and custom machines whose annual demand remains below conventional mass production.
copy.zh: 适用于处理、监测、现场服务与定制设备，其年度需求低于常规大批量生产。

copy.en: Confirm what the sample must prove, current revision, open dimensions, must-use parts, acceptable substitutions, quantity and target review date.
copy.zh: 确认样品要证明什么、当前版本、开放尺寸、必用物料、允许替代、数量与目标评审日期。

copy.en: Create or refine circuit mapping, branch datums, connector views, labels, protection, assumptions and acceptance points.
copy.zh: 创建或完善回路对应、分支基准、接口视图、标签、防护、假设与验收点。

copy.en: Identify production-intent items, temporary parts, manual operations, tooling gaps and which results may not transfer directly to volume production.
copy.zh: 识别量产意向物料、临时部件、手工作业、工装缺口及不能直接迁移到量产的结果。

copy.en: Build to the reviewed data and record deviations, substitutions, rework and actual dimensions instead of correcting them invisibly.
copy.zh: 依据审核资料制作，并记录偏差、替代、返工与实际尺寸，避免无记录修正。

copy.en: Perform the agreed checks only, record setup and results, then distinguish accepted requirements from items that remain open.
copy.zh: 只执行约定检查并记录配置与结果，区分已接受要求和仍待确认项目。

title.zh: 版本放行与下一批制作

copy.en: Convert approved feedback into the next drawing and BOM revision; repeat builds start from that released configuration.
copy.zh: 把批准反馈转化为下一版图纸与BOM，后续制作从该放行配置启动。

copy.en: A result applies to the stated sample, setup and acceptance rule. Temporary materials or incomplete sealing can limit what the result proves.
copy.zh: 结果只适用于规定试样、配置和验收规则，临时材料或不完整密封会限制结论范围。

copy.en: Passing a fit check does not establish bend, vibration or fatigue life. Endurance needs representative routing, fixation and a defined cycle.
copy.zh: 通过装配检查不等于具备弯曲、振动或疲劳寿命，耐久需要代表性路径、固定和明确循环。

copy.en: Jackets, seals, braid and labels used in environmental samples must represent the intended configuration or be recorded as limitations.
copy.zh: 环境样品使用的护套、密封、编织与标签应代表预期配置，否则必须记录为限制。

copy.en: Continuity, polarity, isolation, resistance or other tests follow the approved scope; wiring changes trigger review of affected checks.
copy.zh: 导通、极性、隔离、电阻或其他测试依据批准范围执行，布线变更会触发相关检查复核。

title.zh: 加快验证且不混淆版本

copy.en: Teams can test early while drawings, assumptions and deviations remain visible and traceable.
copy.zh: 团队可以更早测试，同时让图纸、假设与偏差保持可见和可追溯。

copy.en: The gap between a hand-built sample and repeatable production is identified through materials, tooling, work instructions and inspection controls.
copy.zh: 通过物料、工装、作业指导与检验控制识别手工样品和可重复生产之间的差距。

copy.en: Feedback is tied to a specific revision and test purpose, making the next design decision easier to interpret.
copy.zh: 反馈关联具体版本与测试目的，使下一项设计决策更容易判断。

copy.en: Once approved, even low quantities can follow controlled drawings, materials and inspection points instead of rebuilding from memory.
copy.zh: 批准后，即使数量较少也能依据受控图纸、物料与检验点生产，而不是凭记忆重新制作。

q.en: How much information is needed to start a prototype?
q.zh: 开始打样需要多少资料？

a.en: A drawing is helpful but not mandatory. A sample, pin table, connector references, photos and equipment layout can start review when the intended test purpose and open points are stated.
a.zh: 图纸最有帮助但不是必须。只要说明测试目的与待确认项，样品、针脚表、接口资料、照片和设备布局也可启动审核。

q.en: Can temporary materials be used?
q.zh: 可以使用临时物料吗？

a.en: They may be used when the customer accepts the substitution and its effect on fit, function or testing is recorded. Temporary parts are not silently converted into the production BOM.
a.zh: 客户接受且记录其对装配、功能或测试的影响后可以使用，但临时物料不会未经确认直接进入量产BOM。

q.en: Does a working sample mean the design is ready for mass production?
q.zh: 样品能工作就代表可以量产吗？

a.en: No. A functional sample may still use manual methods, provisional dimensions or unqualified materials. Production release requires a controlled design, repeatable process and agreed inspection plan.
a.zh: 不代表。功能样品可能仍使用手工方法、临时尺寸或未完成验证的物料，量产放行需要受控设计、可重复工艺与约定检验计划。

q.en: Can you build from an existing sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有样品制作吗？

a.en: Yes, as a development reference. Hidden electrical functions, mating interfaces, ratings, approved materials and intellectual-property responsibility still need customer confirmation.
a.zh: 可以作为开发参考，但隐藏电气功能、对插接口、额定参数、批准物料与知识产权责任仍需客户确认。

q.en: How are design changes controlled?
q.zh: 设计变更怎样控制？

a.en: Changes are linked to a drawing, BOM, pin map or review record revision. The next build uses the released revision and does not combine undocumented instructions.
a.zh: 变更关联图纸、BOM、针脚表或审核记录版本，下一批依据放行版本制作，不混用未记录指令。

q.en: Can prototypes continue as low-volume production?
q.zh: 样品可以直接转为小批量生产吗？

a.en: Yes after the configuration, substitutions, tooling, work instructions and inspections are reviewed and the customer approves the production reference.
a.zh: 可以，但需要审核配置、替代、工装、作业指导和检验，并由客户批准生产基准。

intro.en: Outdoor waterproof harnesses are designed for equipment exposed to rain, splash, dust, condensation or other defined environments. Waterproof performance belongs to the complete mated connection and cable-entry system, not to the cable alone.
intro.zh: 户外防水线束面向雨水、飞溅、灰尘、冷凝或其他明确环境。防水性能属于完整的插合接口、密封件与出线系统，不能只看线材本身。

knowledge.en: Housing seals, individual wire seals, cavity plugs, connector locks, cable jackets, backshells, branch joints and strain relief all influence ingress protection. Bend loading or an incorrect cable diameter can disturb a rear seal.
knowledge.zh: 壳体密封、单线密封塞、堵孔件、锁止、线缆护套、尾壳、分支接点和应力消除都会影响防护效果；弯曲受力或线径不匹配也可能破坏尾部密封。

notes.en: Define the actual exposure, target protection level or test method, mated connector system, cable diameter, unused cavities, mounting direction, branch treatment and responsibility for final installed validation.
notes.zh: 需要明确实际暴露环境、目标防护等级或测试方法、完整对插系统、线缆外径、空腔处理、安装方向、分支防护以及最终装机验证责任。

delivery.en: The sealing stack and cable-entry dimensions are reviewed before the sample. Assembly controls, continuity and any agreed ingress test are recorded for the project; no universal waterproof claim is made outside that validated configuration.
delivery.zh: 打样前审核密封组合和出线尺寸，项目中记录装配控制、导通和约定的防护测试；未经该配置验证，不作通用防水承诺。

subtitle.en: Sealed connections designed around the real exposure
subtitle.zh: 围绕真实暴露环境设计完整密封连接

lead.en: An outdoor waterproof harness is a complete cable-entry and mated-connector system, not simply a cable with a sealed-looking plug. Housing seals, individual wire seals, cavity plugs, rear covers, jacket diameter, branch joints, strain relief, mating condition and installed orientation all influence ingress. We develop the harness around the stated exposure and an agreed test method, then limit performance claims to the validated configuration.
lead.zh: 户外防水线束是一套完整的出线与插合接口系统，并不是在线缆上安装一个看似密封的插头。壳体密封、单线密封塞、堵孔件、尾盖、护套外径、分支接点、应力消除、插合状态和安装方向都会影响进水。我们围绕明确暴露环境与约定测试方法开发，并把性能结论限制在经过验证的配置内。

benefits.en: What a Defined Sealing System Improves
benefits.zh: 规范密封系统带来的改善

title.en: Rain and splash exposed equipment harness

copy.en: For outdoor cabinets, pumps, valves and field devices exposed to directional rain or splash. Connector orientation, drip paths and cable entry are reviewed with the enclosure.
copy.zh: 适用于受定向雨水或飞溅影响的户外机柜、泵、阀和现场设备，接口方向、滴水路径与出线需要结合外壳审核。

copy.en: Uses an outdoor-suitable jacket and sealed interfaces for exposed runs. UV, temperature, water, oil and flexibility requirements are treated separately.
copy.zh: 外露路径采用适合户外的护套和密封接口，紫外、温度、水、油与柔性要求分别审核。

copy.en: Branch joints can use sealed splice construction, adhesive heat-shrink, overmolding or protected junctions according to the cable geometry and service need.
copy.zh: 分支接点可依据线缆几何与检修需要采用密封接点、带胶热缩、注塑或受保护接线结构。

copy.en: Combines power, control, sensors and communication branches while keeping each cavity seal, unused port and interface direction under configuration control.
copy.zh: 组合供电、控制、传感与通信分支，并让每个孔位密封、空腔处理与接口方向保持受控。

copy.en: Adds flex routing, bend control and connector strain relief for outdoor mechanisms. Movement cannot be allowed to unload or distort the rear seal.
copy.zh: 为户外运动机构增加柔性路径、弯曲控制与接口应力消除，运动不能让尾部密封松脱或变形。

copy.en: For equipment cycling between hot, cold or humid states, materials, venting, low points and condensation paths are reviewed instead of considering rainfall alone.
copy.zh: 对于冷热或湿度循环设备，需要审核材料、通气、低点与冷凝路径，不能只考虑降雨。

title.en: Housing seals, wire seals and cavity plugs
title.zh: 壳体密封、线封与堵孔件

copy.en: Every seal must match the exact housing, terminal, wire insulation diameter and cavity condition. Unused cavities receive the specified plugs rather than improvised filling.
copy.zh: 每个密封件必须匹配准确壳体、端子、线径与孔位状态，未使用孔位采用指定堵孔件而非临时填塞。

copy.en: Current, voltage drop, temperature, flexing and environment define the conductor and insulation; jacket chemistry is checked for sunlight, water, oils and cleaners as applicable.
copy.zh: 依据电流、压降、温度、弯曲与环境定义导体和绝缘，并按需要审核护套对日照、水、油与清洁剂的适应性。

copy.en: Rear covers, glands, boots and clamps protect the cable entry only when sized and tightened for the specified jacket and installation loads.
copy.zh: 尾盖、格兰头、护套与卡箍只有在匹配指定护套并按安装载荷正确装配时，才能保护出线。

copy.en: Where shielding is required, conductive paths and terminations are designed without creating a leak path or compromising the connector sealing stack.
copy.zh: 需要屏蔽时，导电路径与端接应在不形成渗漏路径、不破坏接口密封组合的前提下设计。

title.en: Define the actual exposure before selecting parts
title.zh: 选件前先定义真实暴露

copy.en: Rain, immersion, pressure wash, mud, salt, chemicals, UV and condensation are different duties. The project states which conditions and test references apply.
copy.zh: 雨淋、浸水、压力冲洗、泥污、盐、化学、紫外与冷凝属于不同工况，项目需要明确适用条件和测试依据。

copy.en: Both halves, seals, terminals, cavity plugs, locks, backshells and cable entry are reviewed together, including responsibility for the equipment-side connector.
copy.zh: 对插两端、密封、端子、堵孔、锁止、尾壳与出线共同审核，并明确设备端接口责任。

title.en: Control branch joints and low points
title.zh: 控制分支接点与积水低点

copy.en: Splices, breakouts and label positions are arranged so capillary paths, unsupported bends and water collection do not undermine the sealed interfaces.
copy.zh: 安排接点、分支与标签位置，避免毛细路径、无支撑弯曲与积水破坏密封接口。

title.en: Match inspection to the final installation
title.zh: 检验匹配最终装机状态

copy.en: Continuity, seal assembly and agreed ingress checks are performed on a representative configuration. Final enclosure and mating conditions remain part of system validation.
copy.zh: 在代表性配置上进行导通、密封装配与约定防护检查，最终外壳和插合状态仍属于系统验证的一部分。

title.zh: 户外自动化与生产设备

copy.en: Connects sensors, actuators, controls and field modules around exposed production or material-handling systems.
copy.zh: 连接暴露生产或物料输送系统周围的传感器、执行器、控制与现场模块。

title.zh: 工程与移动机械辅助系统

copy.en: Supports defined low-voltage controls, lighting, sensors and attachments exposed to vibration, mud and service handling.
copy.zh: 支持受振动、泥污与检修操作影响的低压控制、照明、传感器和附件。

title.zh: 户外机器人与运动机构

copy.en: Combines sealing with controlled movement, bend radius, fixation and rear-seal strain relief.
copy.zh: 把密封与运动路径、弯曲半径、固定和尾封应力消除结合设计。

copy.en: Addresses washdown, dust, moisture and replaceable field connections on handling and processing equipment when specifically defined.
copy.zh: 针对搬运与加工设备明确的冲洗、粉尘、湿气与可更换现场接口需求。

copy.en: Routes power and controls between motors, switches, sensors and enclosures with sealed cable entries.
copy.zh: 通过密封出线连接电机、开关、传感器与外壳之间的供电和控制。

copy.en: Connects probes, instruments, communication nodes and service ports where signal integrity and environmental sealing must coexist.
copy.zh: 连接探头、仪器、通信节点与服务接口，使信号完整性与环境密封同时满足。

copy.en: Confirm installation, mating state, direction, water source, temperature, chemicals, movement, target method and acceptance limits.
copy.zh: 确认安装、插合状态、方向、水源、温度、化学、运动、目标方法与验收限值。

copy.en: Define housings, terminals, seals, plugs, jacket diameters, backshells, branch treatment and strain relief as one configuration.
copy.zh: 把壳体、端子、密封、堵孔、护套外径、尾壳、分支与应力消除定义为一个配置。

copy.en: Prepare wires without damaging insulation or seals, crimp to the approved setup, insert cavities and verify lock and seal seating.
copy.zh: 备线时不损伤绝缘与密封，按批准配置压接、入孔并核对锁止和密封就位。

copy.en: Apply approved heat-shrink, boots, glands, overmolding or protective covering while preserving drainage, bend and service access.
copy.zh: 应用批准热缩、护套、格兰头、注塑或防护层，同时保留排水、弯曲与检修空间。

copy.en: Check continuity, polarity, cavity population, locks, seals, plugs, cable entry, labels and workmanship before environmental testing.
copy.zh: 环境测试前检查导通、极性、孔位、锁止、密封、堵孔、出线、标签与工艺。

copy.en: Test only the representative assembly and method agreed for the project, record results and release the exact validated revision.
copy.zh: 只按项目约定方法测试代表性总成，记录结果并放行经过验证的准确版本。

copy.en: Seal hardness, jacket movement, internal air exchange and condensation can change across temperature cycles; these effects require project-defined evaluation.
copy.zh: 密封硬度、护套移动、内部空气交换与冷凝会随温度循环变化，需要按项目定义评估。

title.en: Vibration, bend load and seal disturbance
title.zh: 振动、弯曲载荷与密封扰动

copy.en: Cable weight and movement at the connector rear can disturb seals. Routing, clamps, service loop and strain relief are part of reliability.
copy.zh: 接口尾部的线缆重量与运动可能扰动密封，路径、卡箍、余量与应力消除都属于可靠性设计。

copy.en: Ingress conclusions depend on correct mating, locks, cavity plugs and equipment-side interfaces, not only the supplied harness half.
copy.zh: 防护结论依赖正确插合、锁止、堵孔与设备端接口，而不只取决于所供线束一端。

title.en: Claims tied to method and configuration
title.zh: 性能结论绑定方法与配置

copy.en: Ingress, salt, UV, chemical or washdown claims require defined specimens, conditioning, methods and acceptance limits.
copy.zh: 防护、盐、紫外、化学或冲洗结论需要明确试样、预处理、方法与验收限值。

title.en: Fewer field leaks caused by interface mismatch
title.zh: 减少接口不匹配造成的现场渗漏

copy.en: Wire diameter, seals, plugs and mating hardware are reviewed as a compatible system instead of isolated parts.
copy.zh: 把线径、密封、堵孔与对插硬件作为兼容系统审核，而不是孤立选件。

copy.en: Controlled preparation, insertion, locking, strain relief and inspection points reproduce the approved sealed configuration.
copy.zh: 受控备线、入孔、锁止、应力消除与检验点可以复现批准密封配置。

copy.en: Harness-side, equipment-side and final installed validation responsibilities are identified before performance is claimed.
copy.zh: 在作出性能结论前明确线束端、设备端与最终装机验证责任。

title.zh: 防护匹配真实使用环境

copy.en: Materials and tests follow rain, splash, condensation, movement or chemicals actually present, avoiding both under-design and unsupported over-design.
copy.zh: 材料与测试对应实际存在的雨淋、飞溅、冷凝、运动或化学环境，避免设计不足和无依据的过度设计。

q.en: Is a waterproof connector enough to make the harness waterproof?
q.zh: 使用防水连接器就代表整条线束防水吗？

a.en: No. Both mated halves, seals, cavity plugs, wire diameters, cable entries, branches, strain relief and installed orientation affect the complete result.
a.zh: 不代表。对插两端、密封、堵孔、线径、出线、分支、应力消除与安装方向都会影响完整结果。

q.en: Can you provide a specific IP rating?
q.zh: 可以提供指定IP等级吗？

a.en: A target can be reviewed when the complete configuration, specimen, test method and acceptance criteria are defined. The category name alone is not an IP claim.
a.zh: 完整配置、试样、测试方法与验收标准明确后可以审核目标，小类名称本身不构成IP等级承诺。

q.en: What information is needed for development?
q.zh: 开发需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both mating interfaces, pin map, wire and cable diameters, unused cavities, installation direction, exposure, movement, quantity and the required test reference.
a.zh: 请提供对插两端、针脚、线材与电缆外径、空腔、安装方向、暴露、运动、数量与所需测试依据。

q.en: How are waterproof branches made?
q.zh: 防水分支怎样制作？

a.en: Depending on geometry and service needs, branches may use sealed splices, adhesive heat-shrink, boots, overmolding or protected junctions. The method is project specific.
a.zh: 依据几何与检修需要，分支可使用密封接点、带胶热缩、护套、注塑或受保护接线结构，具体方式按项目确定。

q.en: Does the harness need to be tested while mated?
q.zh: 线束需要在插合状态下测试吗？

a.en: Usually the claimed interface performance belongs to the correctly mated system. Test condition and responsibility for the equipment-side half must be agreed before validation.
a.zh: 通常接口性能属于正确插合的系统，验证前需要约定测试状态和设备端责任。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection plus checks of seals, locks, plugs, entries and workmanship. Ingress or environmental tests follow the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查，并核对密封、锁止、堵孔、出线与工艺；防护或环境测试依据批准计划执行。

intro.en: Low-voltage new-energy harnesses serve auxiliary controllers, sensors, pumps, fans, lighting, communication or diagnostic functions in electric or new-energy equipment. This category does not mean high-voltage traction or battery power cabling.
intro.zh: 新能源低压线束用于电动或新能源设备中的辅助控制器、传感器、泵、风扇、照明、通信或诊断功能。本类别不等同于高压动力或电池主回路线束。

knowledge.en: Low-voltage circuits can still combine power, communication and sensitive signals. Connector keying, current path, fuse strategy, grounding, shielding, sealing and routing must match the actual controller and electrical architecture.
knowledge.zh: 低压系统仍可能同时包含供电、通信和敏感信号。接口防错、电流路径、保险策略、接地、屏蔽、密封和布线必须与实际控制器及电气架构匹配。

notes.en: Provide the platform and controller, nominal and maximum voltage, current by circuit, communication type, pin map, connector references, installation zone and applicable customer specification. High-voltage requests require a separate capability and compliance review.
notes.zh: 需要提供平台与控制器、标称和最高电压、各回路电流、通信类型、针脚图、接口资料、安装区域和客户规范；高压需求必须另行进行能力与合规审核。

delivery.en: Engineering confirms the low-voltage boundary, interfaces and inspection plan before sampling. The approved sample, pin table, labels and agreed electrical checks become the controlled reference for production.
delivery.zh: 打样前确认低压范围、接口和检验计划；获批样品、针脚表、标签和约定的电气检查项目作为受控量产依据。

subtitle.en: Auxiliary power, control, sensing and communication for new-energy equipment
subtitle.zh: 面向新能源设备的辅助供电、控制、传感与通信连接

lead.en: Low-voltage new-energy harnesses connect auxiliary controllers, sensors, interlocks, pumps, fans, lighting, service ports, communication nodes and diagnostic circuits in electric vehicles, charging equipment, energy storage, photovoltaic and other electrified systems. This category excludes high-voltage traction and battery power cabling. The project must define the voltage boundary, circuit currents, protection strategy, connector system, grounding, shielding, sealing and inspection plan for the actual platform.
lead.zh: 新能源低压线束连接电动车辆、充电设备、储能、光伏与其他电气化系统中的辅助控制器、传感器、互锁、泵、风扇、照明、服务接口、通信节点和诊断回路。本类别不包括高压牵引与电池动力电缆。项目必须围绕实际平台定义电压边界、各回路电流、保护策略、接口系统、接地、屏蔽、密封与检验计划。

benefits.en: What a Defined Low-Voltage Architecture Improves
benefits.zh: 明确低压架构带来的改善

title.zh: 辅助控制器与执行器线束

copy.en: Connects low-voltage controllers, relays, contactor coils, pumps, fans and small actuators. Circuit current, inrush and protective device coordination are defined by the platform.
copy.zh: 连接低压控制器、继电器、接触器线圈、泵、风扇与小型执行器，回路电流、启动冲击与保护器件配合由平台定义。

copy.en: Links temperature, pressure, position, current and other sensors to monitoring or control modules with the required reference ground and signal routing.
copy.zh: 把温度、压力、位置、电流等传感器连接到监测或控制模块，并匹配参考地与信号路径要求。

copy.en: Supports low-voltage circulation, cooling and ventilation equipment through sealed branches, controlled current paths and serviceable connectors.
copy.zh: 通过密封分支、受控电流路径与可检修接口支持低压循环、冷却和通风设备。

copy.en: Carries CAN, serial, Ethernet or other project-defined communication and service circuits with controlled pin mapping, pair structure and shielding where required.
copy.zh: 承载CAN、串行、以太网或其他项目定义的通信与服务回路，并按需要控制针脚、线对结构与屏蔽。

title.zh: 互锁与安全相关信号线束

copy.en: Connects access switches, state feedback and defined interlock circuits. Functional safety claims remain a system-level responsibility and require project-specific review.
copy.zh: 连接门控开关、状态反馈与明确的互锁回路；功能安全结论属于系统层面，必须按项目单独审核。

title.en: Lighting, HMI and service accessory harness

copy.en: Organizes low-voltage lighting, displays, switches, maintenance ports and auxiliary accessories into branches matched to the equipment layout.
copy.zh: 把低压照明、显示、开关、维护接口与辅助附件整理成匹配设备布局的分支。

copy.en: Continuous current, inrush, voltage drop, ambient temperature, bundle derating, length and terminal range determine conductor construction and size.
copy.zh: 持续电流、启动冲击、压降、环境温度、成束降额、长度与端子范围共同决定导体结构和规格。

copy.en: Material is chosen for the platform temperature, flexing, oils, coolants, sunlight or cleaning exposure. Colour and labels support assembly but do not replace pin control.
copy.zh: 材料依据平台温度、弯曲、油、冷却液、日照或清洁暴露选择；颜色与标签辅助装配，但不能替代针脚控制。

copy.en: Housing, terminal, seal, cavity plug, lock, wire diameter and mating interface form one compatible system. Keying and colour should follow the equipment architecture.
copy.zh: 壳体、端子、密封、堵孔、锁止、线径与对插接口构成一个兼容系统，防错与颜色应服从设备架构。

title.en: Fuse, relay, grounding and shielding elements
title.zh: 保险、继电器、接地与屏蔽元件

copy.en: Protection and switching components, ground returns, twisted pairs, shields and drain paths are defined with the controller and power-distribution design.
copy.zh: 保护与开关元件、回流地、双绞、屏蔽与排流路径需要配合控制器和配电设计定义。

title.en: Separate low-voltage scope from high-voltage scope

copy.en: Nominal and maximum voltage, isolation boundaries, interfaces and applicable customer rules are confirmed before quotation. High-voltage traction requests enter a separate capability review.
copy.zh: 报价前确认标称与最高电压、隔离边界、接口和适用客户规则；高压牵引需求进入独立能力审核。

title.en: Develop from system architecture and pin data
title.zh: 依据系统架构与针脚资料开发

copy.en: Controller I/O, power distribution, fuse strategy, loads, communication buses, grounding and service interfaces are converted into a controlled harness drawing.
copy.zh: 把控制器I/O、配电、保险策略、负载、通信总线、接地与服务接口转化为受控线束图纸。

copy.en: Branch geometry, pair structure, separation, shield termination and reference grounds are arranged so switching circuits do not unnecessarily disturb sensing or communication.
copy.zh: 通过分支几何、线对结构、隔离、屏蔽端接与参考地布置，减少开关回路对传感与通信的不必要干扰。

title.en: Build prototypes and controlled production looms
title.zh: 制作样品与受控生产线束

copy.en: Prototype feedback is converted into approved pin maps, BOMs, labels, work instructions and inspection points before recurring production.
copy.zh: 样品反馈在重复生产前转化为批准针脚、BOM、标签、作业指导与检验点。

title.zh: 电动与电气化移动设备

copy.en: Supports auxiliary controls, sensing, lighting, communication and service functions outside the high-voltage traction circuit.
copy.zh: 支持高压牵引回路之外的辅助控制、传感、照明、通信与服务功能。

copy.en: Connects low-voltage controllers, indicators, locks, fans, sensors and communication modules in charging cabinets or interfaces.
copy.zh: 连接充电柜或接口中的低压控制器、指示、锁止、风扇、传感器与通信模块。

copy.en: Supports low-voltage sensing, BMS communication, service and auxiliary-control branches while the project defines voltage and isolation boundaries.
copy.zh: 支持低压传感、BMS通信、服务与辅助控制分支，电压和隔离边界由项目明确。

copy.en: Links monitoring boards, fans, indicators, sensors and service interfaces around inverters and control enclosures, excluding their high-energy power paths.
copy.zh: 连接逆变器与控制外壳周围的监测板、风扇、指示、传感与服务接口，不包括其高能量动力路径。

copy.en: Connects auxiliary power distribution, controls, interlocks, pumps and monitoring in electrified production and process equipment.
copy.zh: 连接电气化生产与工艺设备中的辅助配电、控制、互锁、泵与监测。

copy.en: Routes sensors, pumps, valves and fans for defined cooling, heating and environmental-control functions.
copy.zh: 为明确的冷却、加热与环境控制功能连接传感器、泵、阀与风扇。

copy.en: Confirm nominal and maximum voltage, circuit list, loads, controllers, isolation boundaries, installation zones, quantities and applicable specifications.
copy.zh: 确认标称与最高电压、回路、负载、控制器、隔离边界、安装区域、数量与适用规范。

copy.en: Create pin maps, current paths, fuse and relay logic, grounds, communication pairs, branches, connector views and service labels.
copy.zh: 创建针脚、电流路径、保险与继电器逻辑、接地、通信线对、分支、接口视图与服务标签。

copy.en: Select conductors, insulation, connectors, seals, shielding and protection around current, temperature, movement and environmental exposure.
copy.zh: 围绕电流、温度、运动与环境暴露选择导体、绝缘、接口、密封、屏蔽与防护。

copy.en: Prepare, crimp, splice, insert, seal, route, label and protect the harness according to the approved drawing and process setup.
copy.zh: 依据批准图纸与工艺配置完成备线、压接、接点、入孔、密封、布线、标识与防护。

copy.en: Check continuity, polarity, circuit mapping, locks, seals, labels and dimensions plus other project-defined electrical items.
copy.zh: 检查导通、极性、回路对应、锁止、密封、标签与尺寸，以及其他项目定义的电气项目。

copy.en: Approved pin data, BOM, drawing, labels, work instructions and inspection plan become the controlled reference for recurring builds.
copy.zh: 批准针脚、BOM、图纸、标签、作业指导与检验计划成为重复生产的受控基准。

copy.en: Routing, bend radius, branch points, clips and service loops are reviewed so vibration and cable mass do not overload terminals or seals.
copy.zh: 审核路径、弯曲半径、分支、卡扣与检修余量，避免振动和线缆重量使端子或密封过载。

copy.en: Connector sealing, jackets, labels and protective coverings are matched to the stated zone and exposure; new-energy use alone does not define the environment.
copy.zh: 接口密封、护套、标签与防护层匹配明确区域和暴露，新能源用途本身不能代表具体环境。

copy.en: Continuous and transient current, fuse coordination, connector capacity, voltage drop and grounding are reviewed as one low-voltage architecture.
copy.zh: 把持续与瞬态电流、保险配合、接口容量、压降和接地作为完整低压架构审核。

copy.en: Pair geometry, termination, shielding, grounds and branch topology follow the controller specifications and agreed validation method.
copy.zh: 线对几何、端接、屏蔽、接地与分支拓扑服从控制器规范和约定验证方法。

copy.en: Defined branches, labels, connectors and service loops make auxiliary circuits easier to identify and replace.
copy.zh: 明确分支、标签、接口与检修余量，让辅助回路更容易识别和更换。

copy.en: Controlled connector views, keying, cavity data and inspection points reduce ambiguity across engineering and assembly.
copy.zh: 受控接口视图、防错、孔位数据与检验点减少工程和装配中的歧义。

title.en: Better coordination of power and signals

copy.en: Current paths, sensitive circuits, communication pairs, shielding and grounding are developed together instead of as isolated wires.
copy.zh: 把电流路径、敏感回路、通信线对、屏蔽与接地共同开发，而不是孤立处理每根线。

title.zh: 形成可生产的辅助线束系统

copy.en: Drawings, BOMs, work instructions, labels and inspection plans turn a platform architecture into repeatable low-voltage assemblies.
copy.zh: 图纸、BOM、作业指导、标签与检验计划把平台架构转化为可重复低压总成。

q.en: Does this category include high-voltage battery or traction cables?
q.zh: 这个小类包括高压电池或牵引电缆吗？

a.en: No. It covers project-defined low-voltage auxiliary power, control, sensing, communication and diagnostic circuits. High-voltage requests require separate capability and compliance review.
a.zh: 不包括。本小类覆盖项目定义的低压辅助供电、控制、传感、通信与诊断回路，高压需求需要独立能力与合规审核。

q.en: How is the low-voltage boundary defined?
q.zh: 低压边界怎样定义？

a.en: The customer provides nominal and maximum voltage, platform rules, circuit list and isolation boundaries. The label low voltage is not assumed from connector size or application name.
a.zh: 由客户提供标称与最高电压、平台规则、回路与隔离边界，不能根据接口大小或应用名称自行判断。

q.en: Can power and communication circuits share one harness?
q.zh: 供电与通信回路可以放在同一线束里吗？

a.en: They may when current paths, separation, pair structure, shielding, grounding and connector capacity are reviewed for the actual controller architecture.
a.zh: 可以，但必须结合实际控制器架构审核电流路径、隔离、线对结构、屏蔽、接地与接口容量。

q.en: What data is needed for development?
q.zh: 开发需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide the system architecture, voltage and current by circuit, pin maps, connector references, loads, communication type, fuse strategy, installation zone, quantities and applicable customer specifications.
a.zh: 请提供系统架构、各回路电压电流、针脚、接口资料、负载、通信类型、保险策略、安装区域、数量与适用客户规范。

q.en: Can you build from an existing low-voltage sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有低压样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample can support dimensions and circuit mapping, but electrical ratings, hidden protection devices, mating interfaces and platform requirements still require confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可支持尺寸与回路整理，但电气额定、隐藏保护器件、对插接口与平台要求仍需确认。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection plus agreed checks for polarity, circuit mapping, locks, seals, labels and other project-defined electrical items.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查，并按约定检查极性、回路对应、锁止、密封、标签及其他项目定义的电气项目。

intro.en: Overmolded cable assemblies encapsulate the connector-to-cable transition with a selected thermoplastic or elastomer to provide defined strain relief, sealing, touch protection, geometry and appearance. The result depends on the complete interface, cable jacket, molding material, insert preparation and process window.
intro.zh: 包覆成型电缆组件使用指定热塑性材料或弹性体包覆连接器与线缆的过渡区域，以形成明确的应力消除、密封、触摸防护、几何和外观。最终效果取决于完整接口、线缆护套、包胶材料、嵌件处理与工艺窗口。

knowledge.en: A durable overmold is not simply plastic placed around a connector. Resin compatibility, adhesion or mechanical locking, melt temperature, insert temperature, pressure, venting, wall thickness, cable movement and shrinkage all affect cracks, voids, flash, deformation and bond stability.
knowledge.zh: 可靠包胶并不是简单地在连接器外面注塑。树脂兼容性、粘接或机械锁固、熔体温度、嵌件温度、压力、排气、壁厚、线缆移动与收缩都会影响开裂、气孔、飞边、变形和结合稳定性。

notes.en: Provide both interfaces, pin map, cable construction, jacket material and diameter, required molded geometry, colour, hardness, environmental exposure, bend direction, pull loads, quantity and validation method. Existing tooling can be considered only after dimensional and functional review.
notes.zh: 建议提供两端接口、针脚、线缆结构、护套材料与外径、所需包胶几何、颜色、硬度、环境、弯曲方向、拉力、数量与验证方法。现有模具只有在尺寸和功能审核后才能考虑使用。

delivery.en: Engineering first reviews the electrical assembly and molding feasibility. A drawing defines insert position, datums, parting line, gate-sensitive surfaces and cable exit. Tooling, first-off samples, dimensional and electrical checks, agreed mechanical tests and production controls are approved in sequence.
delivery.zh: 工程首先审核电气组件与包胶可行性。图纸定义嵌件位置、基准、分型线、浇口敏感面与出线方向，再依次确认模具、首件、尺寸与电气检查、约定机械测试和生产控制。

subtitle.en: Connector protection, strain relief and molded geometry developed as one system
subtitle.zh: 把接口防护、应力消除与成型几何作为一个系统开发

lead.en: Overmolded cable assemblies cover far more than one connector style. They include straight or angled cable exits, soft strain-relief boots, hard shells, sealed junctions, molded branches, PCB or sensor encapsulation and two-shot constructions. The electrical termination is completed first, then the insert, cable jacket and molding resin are combined through a controlled tool and process. Material labels alone cannot predict adhesion, sealing or flex life, so geometry, preparation and validation must follow the actual assembly.
lead.zh: 包覆成型电缆组件并不局限于某一种接口，可覆盖直出或弯出线、柔性应力护套、硬质外壳、密封接点、成型分支、PCB或传感器封装以及双色结构。电气端接先完成，再通过受控模具与工艺把嵌件、线缆护套和包胶树脂组合起来。单看材料名称无法预测粘接、密封或弯折寿命，因此几何、预处理与验证必须围绕实际总成展开。

solution.zh: 包覆成型工程解决方案

method.zh: 包覆成型电缆制作方法

benefits.zh: 受控包覆成型带来的改善

copy.en: A molded body stabilizes the termination and shapes a straight, side or angled cable exit. The design controls wall thickness, lock access, mating clearance and bend transition.
copy.zh: 成型外壳稳定端接并形成直出、侧出或弯出线，设计需要控制壁厚、锁止操作、插合空间和弯曲过渡。

copy.en: Flexible ribs or a tapered boot distribute bending away from the termination. Hardness, rib spacing, jacket grip and free cable length are tuned for the intended movement.
copy.zh: 柔性筋位或渐变护套把弯曲分散到端接之外，硬度、筋距、护套抓附与自由线长需要匹配预期运动。

copy.en: A rigid molded body can create handling surfaces, polarization, mounting features or touch protection while preserving the original mating interface and tolerances.
copy.zh: 硬质成型外壳可形成握持面、防错、安装结构或触摸防护，同时保留原接口的插合区域与公差。

copy.en: Splices, electronic components or multi-cable breakouts can be encapsulated when cavity filling, heat input, wire position and serviceability are reviewed.
copy.zh: 在审核型腔填充、热输入、线位和可维修性后，可封装接点、电子元件或多线缆分支。

copy.en: Sensitive boards, sensors or modules may use a low-pressure molding route to reduce component loading. Resin, board cleanliness, connector masking and heat exposure remain project specific.
copy.zh: 敏感电路板、传感器或模块可审核低压成型路线以降低器件受力，树脂、板面清洁、接口遮蔽与热暴露仍需按项目确定。

copy.en: A hard or stabilizing pre-mold can secure terminals, shields and components before the final cosmetic or flexible layer is applied. The two materials need a compatible interface.
copy.zh: 硬质或稳定型预注塑可先固定端子、屏蔽与元件，再形成最终外观层或柔性层，两种材料之间必须具备兼容界面。

copy.en: Current, voltage drop, signal function and crimp or solder geometry are confirmed before molding because the finished termination may no longer be accessible for correction.
copy.zh: 包胶后端接通常无法再返修，因此成型前必须确认电流、压降、信号功能以及压接或焊接几何。

copy.en: Metal and plastic inserts need retention features, clean surfaces and controlled clearances. Knurls, undercuts, holes or pre-mold geometry can provide mechanical locking when chemical adhesion is limited.
copy.zh: 金属与塑料嵌件需要保持结构、清洁表面与受控间隙。当化学粘接有限时，可通过滚花、倒扣、孔位或预注塑几何形成机械锁固。

title.en: TPE, TPU, PVC, PA and low-pressure resins

copy.en: Material selection considers hardness, melt temperature, shrinkage, abrasion, oils, chemicals, UV, flammability and compatibility with the insert and cable jacket. No resin is universal.
copy.zh: 材料选择需要考虑硬度、熔融温度、收缩、耐磨、油品、化学、紫外、阻燃，以及与嵌件和线缆护套的兼容性，不存在通用树脂。

copy.en: The cable jacket must tolerate molding heat and pressure without softening, distortion or migration. Surface energy and additives can also change adhesion to the overmold.
copy.zh: 线缆护套必须承受成型热与压力而不软化、变形或迁移，其表面能与添加剂也会改变包胶粘接表现。

title.en: Design from the interface and duty cycle
title.zh: 从接口与工作周期开始设计

copy.en: Mating clearance, user handling, cable pull direction, bending, sealing, chemicals and assembly space define the molded envelope before a tool is selected.
copy.zh: 插合空间、用户操作、拉线方向、弯折、密封、化学环境与装配空间共同定义成型外形，再决定模具方案。

title.en: Review existing tooling without forcing a fit
title.zh: 审核现有模具但不强行套用

copy.en: An existing tool may reduce development work only when insert position, cable diameter, interface clearance, gate, parting line and performance requirements genuinely match.
copy.zh: 只有嵌件位置、线径、接口空间、浇口、分型线与性能要求真正匹配时，现有模具才可能减少开发工作。

title.en: Control insert position and cavity filling
title.zh: 控制嵌件位置与型腔填充

copy.en: Fixtures support connectors, cables, shields and components against injection movement. Gate and vent locations are arranged to fill thin sections without trapping air or displacing wires.
copy.zh: 工装支撑接口、线缆、屏蔽与元件，抵抗注射位移；浇口与排气位置需要让薄壁充分填充，同时避免困气和推移线材。

title.en: Validate the molded assembly, not just its appearance
title.zh: 验证完整成型总成而不只看外观

copy.en: Dimensions, continuity, mating, cable pull, bending, section cuts, sealing or environmental tests are selected according to the actual failure risks and agreed acceptance limits.
copy.zh: 依据真实失效风险与约定限值选择尺寸、导通、插合、拉线、弯折、剖切、密封或环境测试，而不是只判断外观。

copy.en: Overmolding can protect compact interfaces and cable exits on sensors, valves, switches and actuators exposed to handling, vibration or contamination.
copy.zh: 包胶可保护传感器、阀、开关与执行器上的紧凑接口和出线，使其适应操作、振动或污染。

copy.en: Molded connectors provide repeatable handling and strain relief for equipment modules, fixtures and replaceable station cables.
copy.zh: 成型接口为设备模块、工装与可更换工位电缆提供可重复操作和应力消除。

copy.en: Defined boots and rigid bodies protect connectors around oil, chips, vibration and frequent technician handling when materials are matched to the exposure.
copy.zh: 材料匹配环境后，明确的护套与硬质外壳可保护油污、切屑、振动和频繁操作区域的接口。

copy.en: A tuned strain-relief transition can manage repeated cable movement, but flex life still depends on the cable, routing, bend radius and attachment system.
copy.zh: 经过调整的应力过渡可以管理重复运动，但弯折寿命仍取决于线缆、路径、弯曲半径与固定系统。

copy.en: Molded junctions and plugs can combine touch protection, recognizable geometry, cleanability and repeatable assembly around motors, heaters and controls.
copy.zh: 成型接点与插头可在电机、加热和控制连接中结合触摸防护、识别几何、易清洁和可重复装配。

copy.en: Custom exits, shield terminations and compact molded bodies support probes, instruments and fixtures when signal requirements and grounding are defined.
copy.zh: 在信号与接地明确时，定制出线、屏蔽端接与紧凑成型外壳可支持探头、仪器和测试工装。

copy.en: Confirm electrical function, interfaces, cable, molded geometry, environment, loads, colour, quantity, validation and any tooling constraints.
copy.zh: 确认电气功能、接口、线缆、成型几何、环境、载荷、颜色、数量、验证与工装限制。

copy.en: Define insert datums, cable exit, parting line, gate-sensitive faces, wall thickness, strain-relief profile, resin and inspection dimensions.
copy.zh: 定义嵌件基准、出线、分型线、浇口敏感面、壁厚、应力轮廓、树脂与检验尺寸。

title.zh: 电气端接与预注塑准备

copy.en: Complete crimping, soldering, splicing, shield termination and electrical checks, then stabilize and clean the insert for molding.
copy.zh: 完成压接、焊接、接点、屏蔽端接与电气检查，再稳定并清洁嵌件以准备成型。

copy.en: Set insert fixtures, temperature, pressure, speed, cooling and venting, then inspect short shots, flash, sink, cable movement and deformation on first pieces.
copy.zh: 设定嵌件工装、温度、压力、速度、冷却与排气，并在首件检查缺胶、飞边、缩水、线缆位移与变形。

copy.en: Check molded dimensions, mating, continuity, polarity and appearance plus agreed pull, bend, section, ingress or environmental items.
copy.zh: 检查成型尺寸、插合、导通、极性与外观，并执行约定拉力、弯折、剖切、防护或环境项目。

copy.en: Release the approved drawing, BOM, tool setup, sample, work instruction and inspection plan as one controlled production reference.
copy.zh: 把批准图纸、BOM、模具设定、样品、作业指导与检验计划作为一个受控生产基准放行。

title.en: Cable pull, bending and strain transfer

copy.en: Pull load and repeated bending can concentrate at the conductor termination if the boot is too stiff, too short or poorly bonded to the jacket.
copy.zh: 护套过硬、过短或与线缆结合不良时，拉力与重复弯折可能集中到导体端接位置。

title.zh: 化学、湿气与护套相互作用

copy.en: Oils, cleaners, water and plasticizer migration can change resin, jacket and interface behavior. Compatibility needs representative materials and conditioning.
copy.zh: 油、清洁剂、水与增塑剂迁移会改变树脂、护套和界面表现，需要使用代表性材料与预处理验证兼容性。

title.zh: 成型后的内部电气完整性

copy.en: Heat, pressure and insert movement can disturb terminals, solder joints, shields or components, so post-mold electrical checks remain mandatory.
copy.zh: 热、压力与嵌件位移可能影响端子、焊点、屏蔽或元件，因此成型后的电气检查仍然必须执行。

copy.en: Overmolding can support sealing, but any ingress, temperature, flame or endurance claim requires a defined specimen, method and acceptance limit.
copy.zh: 包胶可以支持密封，但任何防护、温度、阻燃或寿命结论都需要明确试样、方法与验收限值。

title.zh: 接口到线缆的过渡更稳定

copy.en: Controlled molded geometry distributes handling and bending loads while protecting the internal termination from direct contact.
copy.zh: 受控成型几何可以分散操作与弯曲载荷，同时保护内部端接不受直接接触。

title.zh: 外形与装配方向可重复

copy.en: Tool-controlled exits, keys, grips and mounting features reduce assembly ambiguity across repeated builds.
copy.zh: 模具控制的出线、防错、握持与安装结构可以减少重复生产中的装配歧义。

title.zh: 紧凑电子件的一体化防护

copy.en: Suitable processes can combine insulation, component support, touch protection and environmental covering within a compact envelope.
copy.zh: 合适工艺可以在紧凑体积中组合绝缘、元件支撑、触摸防护与环境覆盖。

title.zh: 形成受控成型电缆产品

copy.en: Electrical assembly, material set, tool, process settings, dimensions and inspection points are released together instead of treating molding as decoration.
copy.zh: 电气组件、材料组合、模具、工艺设定、尺寸与检验点共同放行，而不是把包胶当作外观装饰。

q.en: What is the difference between overmolding and using a separate boot?
q.zh: 包覆成型与安装独立护套有什么区别？

a.en: Overmolding forms material directly around the insert and cable in a tool, creating a controlled integrated geometry. A separate boot is assembled afterward and may not provide the same retention, sealing or dimensional control.
a.zh: 包覆成型在模具中直接围绕嵌件与线缆形成材料，得到受控一体几何；独立护套在之后装配，其保持、密封与尺寸控制可能不同。

q.en: Which molding material should be used?
q.zh: 应该使用哪种包胶材料？

a.en: The choice depends on hardness, flexing, temperature, chemicals, abrasion, flame requirements, colour, cable-jacket compatibility and processing temperature. A material name alone is not enough.
a.zh: 选择取决于硬度、弯折、温度、化学、耐磨、阻燃、颜色、护套兼容与加工温度，单一材料名称不足以完成选型。

q.en: Can an existing mold be reused?
q.zh: 可以复用现有模具吗？

a.en: Possibly, after insert position, cable diameter, interface clearance, exit direction, parting line, gate and required performance are compared. Similar appearance does not guarantee fit.
a.zh: 可以审核，但需要比较嵌件位置、线径、接口空间、出线方向、分型线、浇口与性能要求，外形相似不代表能够适配。

q.en: Does overmolding automatically make a cable waterproof?
q.zh: 包胶后就自动成为防水电缆吗？

a.en: No. Sealing depends on the complete interface, material compatibility, cable jacket, insert geometry, molding quality, mating condition and the agreed test configuration.
a.zh: 不会。密封取决于完整接口、材料兼容、线缆护套、嵌件几何、成型质量、插合状态与约定测试配置。

q.en: What information is required for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide connector and insert data, pin map, cable construction and diameter, molded dimensions, exit direction, material or hardness target, environment, quantity and required validation. A physical sample can support review.
a.zh: 请提供接口与嵌件资料、针脚、线缆结构和外径、成型尺寸、出线方向、材料或硬度目标、环境、数量与验证要求，实物样品也可辅助审核。

q.en: Which inspections are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些检查？

a.en: Finished assemblies receive continuity and appearance inspection plus dimensional, mating, lock, flash, deformation and other agreed checks. Pull, bend, ingress or environmental tests follow the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查，并核对尺寸、插合、锁止、飞边、变形及其他约定项目；拉力、弯折、防护或环境测试依据批准计划执行。

intro.en: Circular connector cable assemblies cover threaded, bayonet, push-pull, panel-mount, inline, sealed and mixed-contact interfaces for power, signal, communication and sensor circuits. Each assembly is defined by its exact connector family, keying, contact arrangement, cable, backshell and installation environment.
intro.zh: 圆形连接器电缆组件覆盖螺纹、卡口、推拉、面板安装、线对线、密封与混合针芯接口，可承载电源、信号、通信和传感器回路。每条组件都由准确的连接器系列、键位、针芯排列、线缆、尾壳和安装环境共同定义。

knowledge.en: A similar shell diameter does not prove interchangeability. Coupling geometry, keys, insert layout, contact sex, terminal range, seals and backshell threads must all match the mating interface and cable construction.
knowledge.zh: 外壳直径相似并不能证明可以互换。锁紧几何、键位、绝缘体孔位、接触件性别、端子线径范围、密封件与尾部螺纹都必须匹配对插接口和线缆结构。

notes.en: Provide the connector series and part number when known, clear views of both mating faces and keying, a pin map, circuit ratings, cable length and structure, panel details, exit direction, environment, quantity and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 建议提供已知的连接器系列与料号、双方插合面和键位清晰照片、针脚定义、回路额定、线长与结构、面板资料、出线方向、环境、数量和验证要求。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the interface, circuit map, cable and rear accessories before the first build. Termination, contact insertion, shield treatment, sealing and backshell assembly are inspected before continuity, mating, locking, dimensional and project-specific validation.
delivery.zh: 工程在首件前冻结接口、回路、线缆与尾部附件。端接、插针、屏蔽处理、密封和尾壳装配完成检查后，再进行导通、插合、锁紧、尺寸与项目专项验证。

subtitle.en: One cylindrical interface, many coupling systems and circuit architectures
subtitle.zh: 一个圆柱形界面，覆盖多种锁紧系统与回路架构

lead.en: Circular connector is a category, not a single part. We develop complete cable assemblies around the customer's mating equipment, including power-only, signal-only, shielded communication, sensor, hybrid and sealed configurations. Selection begins with the exact mechanical interface and contact map, then extends through conductor, cable, shielding, sealing, strain relief, installation and verification.
lead.zh: 圆形连接器是一个类别，不是单一料号。我们围绕客户设备端接口开发完整电缆组件，可覆盖纯电源、纯信号、屏蔽通信、传感器、混合与密封配置。选型从准确机械接口与孔位定义开始，再延伸到导体、线缆、屏蔽、密封、应力消除、安装和验证。

copy.en: A limited rotation seats and retains the plug, reducing connection time where repeated access is expected.
copy.zh: 通过有限角度旋转完成插合与保持，适用于需要较快连接和拆卸的设备。

copy.en: Slots, pins, spring preload and final rotation must reach the defined position. A connector that feels tight may still be incompletely seated.
copy.zh: 卡槽、销钉、弹簧预载与最终旋转位置必须达到规定状态，手感变紧并不等于已经完全到位。

copy.en: Hand clearance, visibility and cable direction are reviewed so technicians can lock and release the coupling without twisting the cable.
copy.zh: 需要审核手部空间、可视性与线缆方向，使人员不扭转线缆即可完成锁紧和释放。

copy.en: Threaded coupling progressively draws the plug and receptacle together and can provide positive retention with controlled seal compression.
copy.zh: 螺纹耦合逐步拉紧插头与插座，可形成明确保持并控制密封压缩。

copy.en: Thread form, engagement length, shell size, keys and insert depth all require confirmation. Being able to start the thread does not prove compatibility.
copy.zh: 螺纹形式、旋合长度、壳号、键位和绝缘体深度都需确认，能够起牙不代表可以互配。

copy.en: Straight alignment, accessible coupling surfaces and a defined tightening method reduce damaged threads and partially mated contacts.
copy.zh: 同轴对准、可操作的耦合面与明确锁紧方法，可减少螺纹损伤和触点未完全插合。

copy.en: Axial mating and a release sleeve support frequent handling in instruments, test systems and compact equipment.
copy.zh: 轴向插合与释放套筒适合仪器、测试系统和紧凑设备中的频繁操作。

copy.en: The key and alignment marks must be identified before mating. Forcing a misaligned insert can damage contacts or the insulator.
copy.zh: 插合前必须识别键位和对准标记，错位强插可能损伤触点或绝缘体。

copy.en: Disconnection force belongs on the release mechanism, not the cable. Rear grip and service loop are designed around the real handling direction.
copy.zh: 拆卸力应作用于释放机构而不是线缆，尾部握持与检修余量应围绕真实操作方向设计。

title.zh: 面板插座与电缆端插头

copy.en: Panel thickness, fixing method, rear clearance, mating depth and connector orientation are treated as one mechanical interface.
copy.zh: 面板厚度、固定方式、后部空间、插合深度与接口方向需要作为同一机械界面审核。

copy.en: Mounting geometry must prevent rotation and preserve access to keys, latches and rear termination hardware.
copy.zh: 安装几何需要防止接口转动，并保留键位、锁紧件和尾部端接的操作空间。

copy.en: Without panel support, suspended mass, pull load, fixation points and backshell strain relief become part of the harness design.
copy.zh: 没有面板支撑时，悬挂重量、拉力、固定点与尾壳应力消除都必须纳入线束设计。

copy.en: Shell size alone cannot identify the electrical interface. Every cavity is mapped to function, contact sex, terminal type and conductor range.
copy.zh: 只看壳号无法识别电气接口，每个孔位都要对应功能、接触件性别、端子类型和导体范围。

copy.en: Pin tables state whether the view is the mating face or wire side and whether contacts are pins or sockets, preventing mirrored wiring.
copy.zh: 针脚表需要注明插合面或接线面视图，并标明针式或孔式触点，避免镜像接线。

copy.en: Large power contacts, small signal contacts, coaxial modules or paired communication circuits require separate conductor and inspection rules.
copy.zh: 大电流触点、小信号触点、同轴模块或成对通信回路，需要分别定义导体与检验规则。

title.zh: 键位也是电气防错结构

copy.en: Primary keys, secondary keys and coded inserts prevent incompatible circuits from being connected in the same equipment family.
copy.zh: 主键、副键和编码绝缘体用于阻止同一设备家族中的不兼容回路被错误连接。

title.en: Do not identify by colour alone

copy.en: Colour can assist operation but does not replace series, coding, contact map and mating-part verification.
copy.zh: 颜色可以辅助操作，但不能替代系列、编码、孔位与对插件验证。

copy.en: A useful reference set includes the mating face, side profile, key location, markings and the equipment receptacle, all in focus.
copy.zh: 有效参考资料应包括插合面、侧面、键位、标识和设备端插座，并保证结构清晰。

copy.en: The connector series defines permitted contacts and tools; the cable construction determines how each conductor reaches that contact.
copy.zh: 连接器系列规定允许使用的触点与工装，线缆结构则决定每根导体如何进入对应触点。

copy.en: Terminal, conductor size, strand structure, strip length, applicator and inspection criteria are matched as one process.
copy.zh: 端子、线径、绞线结构、剥线长度、工装和检验标准需要作为一个完整工艺匹配。

copy.en: Solder quantity, heat input, wicking and insulation recession are controlled to protect flexible conductors and contact alignment.
copy.zh: 需要控制焊料量、热输入、爬锡和绝缘回缩，以保护柔性导体与触点对准。

title.en: Backshell, exit angle and strain relief
title.zh: 尾壳、出线角度与应力消除

copy.en: Straight and angled rear hardware change installation space, bend path, cable clamp position and service access.
copy.zh: 直式与弯式尾部附件会改变安装空间、弯曲路径、线夹位置和维护操作。

title.en: Clamp the jacket, not the conductors

copy.en: A correct clamp transfers pull and bending into the backshell. Too little grip loads the contacts; too much can crush the jacket.
copy.zh: 正确夹持把拉力与弯曲传递到尾壳，过松会让触点受力，过紧则可能压伤护套。

copy.en: For angled exits, clocking is frozen on the drawing so the cable clears nearby walls, covers and moving parts after installation.
copy.zh: 弯出线方向需要在图纸中冻结，确保装机后避开邻近外壳、盖板和运动部件。

title.en: Metal shells do not create shielding by themselves
title.zh: 金属外壳不会自动形成有效屏蔽

copy.en: Shield performance depends on the continuous path from cable braid through rear hardware and shell to the panel and system ground.
copy.zh: 屏蔽表现取决于从线缆编织层、尾部附件、壳体到面板与系统地的连续路径。

title.zh: 端接几何需要匹配频率
